pairs.en: supplies unchanged. The theorem is what licenses reasoning about a Cordis application as though it were stati - cally assembled. An orchestrator that adds a component, removes it, replaces a provider, and reverts the replacement is guaranteed to arrive at the state it would have obtained by writing the final composition down at the outset, and a component author reasoning about which coeffects are in scope may reason about the quiescent state alone. It also delimits the guarantee: it speaks of the state, not of the emissions the system produced along the way, which is the distinction Section 6.1 draws between an acquisition, tracked inside the boundary, and an emission, which crosses it.
pairs.zh: 原样提供。该定理授权将 Cordis 应用当作静态组装来推理。添加组件、移除它、替换提供者并回退替换的编排器，被保证到达它若一开始就写下最终复合所会得到的状态；推理哪些共效应在作用域内的组件作者可只关于静止状态推理。它也划定保证：它谈状态，而不谈系统沿途所产生的排放，这正是第 6.1 节在边界内追踪的获取与跨越边界的排放之间所作的区分。

pairs.en: 4.4. Metatheory
pairs.zh: 4.4. 元理论

pairs.en: Section  4.3 supplies ten rules: the three orchestration rules of Section  4.2; L-Begin, L-Iter, and L-Finish for an activation; L-Divert and L-Raise for the two ways an activation may end early; and L-Leave and L-Unload for a deactivation. This section reads the two dimensions of composability off those rules in their global form, one fiber’s guarantee holding whatever the other fibers do in between, and adds what only a whole system can be asked for: that it always reaches the configuration its targets call for, and that the configuration is the one a static assembly would have produced. Every property below is a property of a sequence of steps, so we index the steps and read the fields of a state off that index. Two conventions carry Section 3.3.2 into this section. Every equality between states below is read up to the observational equivalence ≃ of Definition 33, as Lemma 38 reads those of Section 3.1, and the witness condition an effect function is held to is the one Definition 37 gives, read of an iterator as Definition 51 gives it and of a registering iteration at the ≈ below.
pairs.zh: 第 4.3 节提供十条规则：第 4.2 节的三条编排规则；用于激活的 L-Begin、L-Iter 与 L-Finish；用于激活可能提前结束的两种方式的 L-Divert 与 L-Raise；以及用于停用的 L-Leave 与 L-Unload。本节从这些规则的全局形式读出可复合性的两个维度——一个 fiber 的保证无论其他 fiber 在其间做什么都成立——并添加只有整个系统才能被要求者：它总是到达其目标所要求的配置，且该配置是静态组装所会产生者。下文每个性质都是步骤序列的性质，故我们为步骤编制下标并从该下标读出状态的字段。两个约定将第 3.3.2 节带入本节。下文状态之间的每个等式都按定义 33 的观察等价 ≃ 解读，正如引理 38 解读第 3.1 节的那些；效应函数所遵守的见证条件是定义 37 所给者，对迭代器按定义 51 解读，对注册迭代按下述 ≈ 解读。

pairs.en: Proof. Let step 𝑡 apply 𝑟 at 𝑛. By Definition 53 it factors as edit𝑡 ∘ Ψ𝑡, where edit𝑡 writes the fields the fifth column of Table 1 names and nothing else, and Ψ𝑡 is idΓ, an application of one of 𝑛’s iterations, or the accumulator 𝑔𝑡 𝑛, which is a composite of the inverses those iterations yielded. Each of the three is confined to 𝑛 by Definition 48, so Ψ𝑡 writes no field of a fiber present at 𝛾𝑡 but 𝜎𝑛, together with the entry a registration adds and the 𝜏 its inverse writes. The two halves therefore partition the writes, and each clause is that partition read at one field. One reading of the second and third columns is used twice: 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 is the one lifecycle state carrying no committed view, L-Begin the one rule leading out of it, and L-Unload the one rule leading into it, while every other row carries the 𝜔 of its premise into its conclusion unchanged. (1) An edit𝑡 writes no table, the fifth column naming none, and a Ψ𝑡 writes no 𝜎𝑚 for a present 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛.
pairs.zh: 证明。设步骤 𝑡 在 𝑛 处应用 𝑟。由定义 53 它分解为 edit𝑡 ∘ Ψ𝑡，其中 edit𝑡 写入表 1 第五列所命名的字段且别无其他，而 Ψ𝑡 是 idΓ、𝑛 某次迭代的应用，或累加器 𝑔𝑡 𝑛——那些迭代所给出逆的复合。由定义 48 三者都约束于 𝑛，故 Ψ𝑡 除 𝜎𝑛 外不写入 𝛾𝑡 处出现的 fiber 的任何字段，连同注册所添加的条目及其逆所写的 𝜏。因此两半划分写入，每个条款是该划分在一个字段上的解读。第二列与第三列的一种解读被用两次：𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 是不携带已提交视图的唯一生命周期状态，L-Begin 是离开它的唯一规则，L-Unload 是进入它的唯一规则，而其他每行都将前提的 𝜔 不变地带入结论。(1) edit𝑡 不写入表，第五列不命名任何表，且 Ψ𝑡 不为出现的 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 写入任何 𝜎𝑚。

pairs.en: So 𝜎𝑚 can move only at 𝑚 = 𝑛, and only inside Ψ𝑡. (2) 𝜔𝑛 is a constituent of 𝜃𝑛, which only an edit𝑡 writes and only at the fiber the step acts on, so by the reading above 𝜔𝑛 comes into existence at an L-Begin of 𝑛 and ceases at an L-Unload of 𝑛. An episode of 𝑛 is an interval on which installed𝑛 holds, hence one throughout which 𝜔𝑛 is defined, so neither rule falls in its interior. A step acting on some 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 writes no 𝜃𝑛, and the entry a registration adds is at a name not present at 𝛾𝑡. (5) No row of the fifth column names a 𝜋, 𝑑, 𝑝, or 𝑒;

pairs.en: Proof. Every premise of Section 4.3 is of one of four kinds, and each reads a constituent the relation keeps. A premise matching 𝜃𝑛 or 𝜏𝑛 against a pattern, and the premise ∀𝑚. 𝜋𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 of O-Remove, read control fields. The premises (𝑑, 𝑝, 𝑒) ∈ ℭΓ and ∀𝑚. 𝑝 ∩ 𝑝𝑚 = ⌀ of O-Insert read 𝑑, 𝑝, and 𝑒. A premise mentioning target𝑛 or relied𝑛 reads 𝜏𝑛, the committed views inside the 𝜃𝑚, and dom(𝜎𝛾), which Definition 45 computes from the 𝜃𝑚 and the dom(𝜎𝑚), and Definition 33 relates two coeffect contexts only where their domains agree. The remaining premises read dom(𝐹𝛾). None reads a value 𝜎𝛾(𝑘) otherwise than up to ≃𝑘 , so no premise separates two ≃-related states. For the conclusion, 𝛾𝑡+1 = edit𝑡(Ψ𝑡(𝛾𝑡)) by Definition 53. The values an edit𝑡 assigns are the constituents of the premises it matched, related at the two states by the paragraph above and by Definition 51, which relates the triples an iterator yields at ≃-related states.
pairs.zh: 证明。第 4.3 节的每个前提属于四种之一，每种都读取关系所保持的成分。将 𝜃𝑛 或 𝜏𝑛 与模式匹配的前提，以及 O-Remove 的前提 ∀𝑚. 𝜋𝑚 ≠ 𝑛，读取控制字段。O-Insert 的前提 (𝑑, 𝑝, 𝑒) ∈ ℭΓ 与 ∀𝑚. 𝑝 ∩ 𝑝𝑚 = ⌀ 读取 𝑑、𝑝 与 𝑒。提及 target𝑛 或 relied𝑛 的前提读取 𝜏𝑛、𝜃𝑚 内的已提交视图，以及 dom(𝜎𝛾)，定义 45 从 𝜃𝑚 与 dom(𝜎𝑚) 计算后者，而定义 33 仅在定义域一致时关联两个共效应上下文。其余前提读取 dom(𝐹𝛾)。没有任何前提以超出 ≃𝑘 的方式读取值 𝜎𝛾(𝑘)，故没有任何前提分离两个 ≃-相关的状态。对结论，由定义 53，𝛾𝑡+1 = edit𝑡(Ψ𝑡(𝛾𝑡))。edit𝑡 所赋的值是其所匹配前提的成分，在两状态由上一段以及定义 51 相关，后者在 ≃-相关状态处关联迭代器所给出的三元组。

pairs.en: And Ψ𝑡 respects ≃: it is idΓ, or an iteration of 𝑒𝑛, which Definition 51 requires to respect ≃, or the accumulator inside 𝜃𝑛, a composite of inverses each respecting ≃ by the same definition. □ The names a state carries are read by two of those observations, dom(𝐹𝛾) and the indexing of the control fields, and the rule that draws a name draws any name not already in use (Definition 47). Reading the results below up to ≃ therefore also calls for reading them up to a renaming, which is the discipline of Section 4.1 cashed out.

pairs.en: Lemma 56. (Equivariance.) Let 𝜒 : 𝔑 → 𝔑 be a bijection and let 𝜒 ⋅ 𝛾 be the state carrying the
pairs.zh: 引理 56.（等变性。）设 𝜒 : 𝔑 → 𝔑 为双射，并设 𝜒 ⋅ 𝛾 为承载

pairs.en: registry 𝐹𝛾 ∘ 𝜒−1, with every name occurring in a 𝜋𝑚 or an 𝜔𝑚 replaced by its image. Then 𝜒 ⋅ 𝛾 is a state, well formed where 𝛾 is, and step𝑡 = 𝑟(𝑛) carries 𝛾𝑡 to 𝛾𝑡+1 if and only if 𝑟(𝜒(𝑛)) carries 𝜒 ⋅ 𝛾𝑡 to 𝜒 ⋅ 𝛾𝑡+1.
pairs.zh: 注册表 𝐹𝛾 ∘ 𝜒−1 的状态，其中出现在 𝜋𝑚 或 𝜔𝑚 中的每个名字都由其像替换。则 𝜒 ⋅ 𝛾 是状态，在 𝛾 良构处良构，且 step𝑡 = 𝑟(𝑛) 将 𝛾𝑡 带到 𝛾𝑡+1 当且仅当 𝑟(𝜒(𝑛)) 将 𝜒 ⋅ 𝛾𝑡 带到 𝜒 ⋅ 𝛾𝑡+1。

pairs.en: Proof. A premise reads a name only by comparing it with another, whether directly, as in the freshness 𝑛 ∉ dom(𝐹𝛾) of O-Insert and the ∀𝑚. 𝜋𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 of O-Remove, or through a table of names, as target𝑛 and relied𝑛 read the 𝜋𝑚 and the 𝜔𝑚. A bijection preserves each such comparison. The only names a rule writes are the 𝜋 that O-Insert sets and the 𝜔 that L-Begin sets, both taken from what its premises read, so the writes commute with 𝜒; an effect function writes no name at all, drawing one only through the primitive of Definition 47, which Definition 48 confines to the entry that primitive adds. Well-formedness ( Definition 58) is four conditions comparing names with names. □ A sequence and its renaming therefore take the same rules in the same order and reach states differing by 𝜒 alone. Two sequences agreeing save in the names their registrations draw are accordingly identified, and the results below are read up to the renaming that identifies them.
pairs.zh: 证明。前提仅通过将名字与另一名字比较来读取名字，无论是直接比较——如 O-Insert 的新鲜性 𝑛 ∉ dom(𝐹𝛾) 与 O-Remove 的 ∀𝑚. 𝜋𝑚 ≠ 𝑛——还是通过名字表——如 target𝑛 与 relied𝑛 读取 𝜋𝑚 与 𝜔𝑚。双射保持每一次此种比较。规则所写的唯一名字是 O-Insert 所设的 𝜋 与 L-Begin 所设的 𝜔，二者都取自其前提所读者，故写入与 𝜒 交换；效应函数根本不写名字，仅经定义 47 的原语取一个，而定义 48 将其约束于该原语所添加的条目。良构性（定义 58）是四个比较名字与名字的条件。□ 因此序列及其重命名按相同顺序取相同规则，并到达仅差 𝜒 的状态。除其注册所取名字外一致的两个序列因而被等同，下文结果按等同它们的重命名解读。

pairs.en: Proof. A vestigial 𝑛 contributes to no observation a premise of a rule acting on 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 reads. It is not 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾, so 𝜎𝑛 enters no 𝜎𝛾 and 𝑛 is the provider of no key, leaving 𝛾 ⊧ 𝑑𝑚 and target𝑚 unmoved; installed𝑛 fails, so 𝑛 contributes no disjunct to relied𝑚; no 𝜋𝑚′ names 𝑛, so the premise ∀𝑚′. 𝜋𝑚′ ≠ 𝑚 of an O-Remove of 𝑚 is unmoved; and 𝜃𝑛, 𝜏𝑛, and 𝜋𝑛 are read by rules acting on 𝑛 alone. The two premises clause (2) excepts are the two the removal relaxes, an absent name being fresh and an absent provision meeting every other. By Lemma 54 no rule acting on 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 writes a field of 𝑛, so the entry survives, and the state map of the step is confined to 𝑚 by Definition 48, so it leaves 𝜎𝑛 empty. □ Simplifying the lifecycle states, together with the rules that match on them, yields a subcalculus, and not every result survives the simplification.
pairs.zh: 证明。残余的 𝑛 对作用于 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 的规则之前提所读的任何观察都无贡献。它不是 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾，故 𝜎𝑛 不进入任何 𝜎𝛾，𝑛 不是任何键的提供者，留下 𝛾 ⊧ 𝑑𝑚 与 target𝑚 不动；installed𝑛 失败，故 𝑛 不对 relied𝑚 贡献任何析取；没有任何 𝜋𝑚′ 命名 𝑛，故对 𝑚 的 O-Remove 的前提 ∀𝑚′. 𝜋𝑚′ ≠ 𝑚 不动；而 𝜃𝑛、𝜏𝑛 与 𝜋𝑛 仅由作用于 𝑛 的规则读取。条款 (2) 所例外的两个前提正是移除所放宽的两个，缺席名字新鲜且缺席提供与其他每个相交为空。由引理 54，作用于 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 的规则不写入 𝑛 的任何字段，故条目幸存；且由定义 48 该步的状态映射约束于 𝑚，故留下 𝜎𝑛 为空。□ 简化生命周期状态连同匹配它们的规则得到子演算，并非每个结果都在简化下幸存。

pairs.en: Dropping Section 4.3.1 is the case that matters, which is the division Section 4.3 opens with, read from the metatheory’s side: its guard is what establishes clauses (3) and (4) of Definition 58, and Theorem 63 rests on the interval the guard creates, so those three fail without it. What the other three subsections add can be simplified away without disturbing the results below, each of them only adding rules to the one state space Definition 49 fixes.
pairs.zh: 丢掉第 4.3.1 节是要紧的情形，这是第 4.3 节开篇的划分，从元理论一侧解读：其守卫确立定义 58 的条款 (3) 与 (4)，定理 63 依赖守卫所创造的区间，故没有它这三者失败。其他三个小节所添加者可被简化掉而不扰动下文结果，它们各自只向定义 49 所固定的同一状态空间添加规则。

pairs.en: 4.4. Metatheory
pairs.zh: 4.4. 元理论

pairs.en: Section  4.3 supplies ten rules: the three orchestration rules of Section  4.2; L-Begin, L-Iter, and L-Finish for an activation; L-Divert and L-Raise for the two ways an activation may end early; and L-Leave and L-Unload for a deactivation. This section reads the two dimensions of composability off those rules in their global form, one fiber’s guarantee holding whatever the other fibers do in between, and adds what only a whole system can be asked for: that it always reaches the configuration its targets call for, and that the configuration is the one a static assembly would have produced. Every property below is a property of a sequence of steps, so we index the steps and read the fields of a state off that index. Two conventions carry Section 3.3.2 into this section. Every equality between states below is read up to the observational equivalence ≃ of Definition 33, as Lemma 38 reads those of Section 3.1, and the witness condition an effect function is held to is the one Definition 37 gives, read of an iterator as Definition 51 gives it and of a registering iteration at the ≈ below.
pairs.zh: 第 4.3 节提供十条规则：第 4.2 节的三条编排规则；用于激活的 L-Begin、L-Iter 与 L-Finish；用于激活可能提前结束的两种方式的 L-Divert 与 L-Raise；以及用于停用的 L-Leave 与 L-Unload。本节从这些规则的全局形式读出可复合性的两个维度——一个 fiber 的保证无论其他 fiber 在其间做什么都成立——并添加只有整个系统才能被要求者：它总是到达其目标所要求的配置，且该配置是静态组装所会产生者。下文每个性质都是步骤序列的性质，故我们为步骤编制下标并从该下标读出状态的字段。两个约定将第 3.3.2 节带入本节。下文状态之间的每个等式都按定义 33 的观察等价 ≃ 解读，正如引理 38 解读第 3.1 节的那些；效应函数所遵守的见证条件是定义 37 所给者，对迭代器按定义 51 解读，对注册迭代按下述 ≈ 解读。

pairs.en: Definition 53. Index the steps by 𝑡, so that 𝛾𝑡 is the state the first 𝑡 of them reach, and write
pairs.zh: 定义 53. 以 𝑡 为步骤编制下标，使 𝛾𝑡 为前 𝑡 步所达状态，并写

pairs.en: step𝑡 ≔ 𝑟(𝑛) (50) for the step taken at 𝛾𝑡: the rule 𝑟 it applies, one of the ten, and the name 𝑛 ∈ 𝔑 it applies that rule at. The sequence starts at a 𝛾0 with dom(𝐹0) = ⌀, so every fiber comes into existence by an O-Insert, whether the orchestrator’s or one an iteration takes ( Definition 47). A field of 𝛾𝑡 carries the index as a superscript, so that 𝜃𝑡 𝑛, 𝜔𝑡 𝑛, 𝜎𝑡 𝑛, 𝑔𝑡 𝑛, and 𝑖𝑡 𝑛 are the lifecycle state, committed view, table, accumulator, and remaining iterator of 𝑛 at 𝛾𝑡, and 𝐹𝑡 and 𝜎𝑡 the registry and coeffect context of 𝛾𝑡 itself, the 𝐹𝛾 and 𝜎𝛾 of Definition 45 read there. Predicates take the state as their argument and everything else as a subscript, so installed𝑡 𝑛, target𝑡 𝑛, relied𝑡 𝑛, and quiet𝑡 are the predicates of Definition 46, Definition 49, and Definition 50 at 𝛾𝑡. An episode of 𝑛 is a maximal interval [𝑏, 𝑢] of indices throughout which installed𝑡 𝑛 holds. It opens at 𝑏, where 𝑏 > 0 and ¬ installed𝑏−1 𝑛 , the empty 𝐹0 leaving no fiber installed at the outset;
pairs.zh: step𝑡 ≔ 𝑟(𝑛) (50) 表示在 𝛾𝑡 处所取的步骤：它所应用的规则 𝑟（十条之一），以及它将该规则应用于的名字 𝑛 ∈ 𝔑。序列从 dom(𝐹0) = ⌀ 的 𝛾0 开始，故每个 fiber 都由 O-Insert 产生，无论是编排器的还是迭代所取的（定义 47）。𝛾𝑡 的字段以下标携带索引，使 𝜃𝑡 𝑛、𝜔𝑡 𝑛、𝜎𝑡 𝑛、𝑔𝑡 𝑛 与 𝑖𝑡 𝑛 为 𝑛 在 𝛾𝑡 处的生命周期状态、已提交视图、表、累加器与剩余迭代器，𝐹𝑡 与 𝜎𝑡 为 𝛾𝑡 本身的注册表与共效应上下文，即定义 45 的 𝐹𝛾 与 𝜎𝛾 在那里的解读。谓词以状态为参数、其余为下标，故 installed𝑡 𝑛、target𝑡 𝑛、relied𝑡 𝑛 与 quiet𝑡 是定义 46、定义 49 与定义 50 在 𝛾𝑡 处的谓词。𝑛 的插曲是 installed𝑡 𝑛 始终成立的极大下标区间 [𝑏, 𝑢]。它在 𝑏 打开，其中 𝑏 > 0 且 ¬ installed𝑏−1 𝑛，空的 𝐹0 使一开始没有 fiber 已安装；

pairs.en: it closes at 𝑢 when installed𝑢 𝑛 and not installed𝑢+1 𝑛 , which a final episode need not do. Every rule of Section 4.3 concludes in the shape 𝛾 ⟶ 𝛿[⋯], where the premises compute 𝛿 from 𝛾 and leave it as 𝛾 where they compute nothing, and the bracket edits named fields of the registry. The two halves are named separately, and both are maps on all of Γ. The state map of a step taken at 𝛾𝑡 by a rule acting on 𝑛 is Ψ𝑡 ≔ { pr1 ∘ 𝑖 at L-Iter, L-Finish, and a landing L-Divert 𝑔 at L-Unload idΓ at every other rule (51) where 𝑖 and 𝑔 are the iterator and the accumulator that 𝜃𝑡 𝑛 carries, and the edit edit𝑡 : Γ → Γ is the bracket read as a function, assigning to the fields it names the values the premises computed at 𝛾𝑡. Both are therefore fixed by step𝑡 together with 𝛾𝑡 and defined at every state, which is what lets Theorem 61 and Lemma 71 evaluate them away from 𝛾𝑡.
pairs.zh: 当 installed𝑢 𝑛 且非 installed𝑢+1 𝑛 时它在 𝑢 关闭，最终插曲不必如此。第 4.3 节的每条规则都以 𝛾 ⟶ 𝛿[⋯] 的形状结束，其中前提从 𝛾 计算 𝛿，在计算无所得处留下它为 𝛾，而方括号编辑注册表的命名字段。两半分别命名，二者都是整个 Γ 上的映射。在 𝛾𝑡 处由作用于 𝑛 的规则所取步骤的状态映射为 Ψ𝑡 ≔ {pr1 ∘ 𝑖 于 L-Iter、L-Finish 与落地的 L-Divert；𝑔 于 L-Unload；idΓ 于每条其他规则} (51) 其中 𝑖 与 𝑔 是 𝜃𝑡 𝑛 所携带的迭代器与累加器，而编辑 edit𝑡 : Γ → Γ 是作为函数解读的方括号，将前提在 𝛾𝑡 处所计算的值赋给它所命名的字段。因此二者都由 step𝑡 连同 𝛾𝑡 固定，并在每个状态有定义，这正使定理 61 与引理 71 能在远离 𝛾𝑡 处求值它们。

pairs.en: Each step factors as 𝛾𝑡+1 = edit𝑡(Ψ𝑡(𝛾𝑡)) (52) At L-Unload, for instance, edit𝑡 is [𝜃𝑛 ↦ 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(𝜁)], and at O-Remove it is the removal ∖ 𝑛, which is why the second half is an edit rather than an assignment. The fields divide along the same seam: the tables 𝜎𝑚, which no edit𝑡 writes once the O-Insert creating 𝑚 has set it empty, and the control fields 𝜃𝑚, 𝜏𝑚, 𝜋𝑚, 𝑑𝑚, 𝑝𝑚, 𝑒𝑚 together with dom(𝐹𝛾), which no Ψ𝑡 writes save through the primitive of Definition 47. Write 𝛾 ≈ 𝛿 when two states agree on everything but the control fields. The relation ≈ is not the ≃ of Definition 33, and neither refines the other, because each forgets what the other has to keep. Recovery exactness is a claim about effects, so ≈ compares the tables and the ambient state exactly and forgets only the registry’s record of which fiber installed them.
pairs.zh: 每一步分解为 𝛾𝑡+1 = edit𝑡(Ψ𝑡(𝛾𝑡)) (52) 例如在 L-Unload，edit𝑡 是 [𝜃𝑛 ↦ 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(𝜁)]，在 O-Remove 它是移除 ∖ 𝑛，这正是后半是编辑而非赋值的原因。字段沿同一接缝划分：表 𝜎𝑚——一旦创建 𝑚 的 O-Insert 将其设为空，没有任何 edit𝑡 写入它们——以及控制字段 𝜃𝑚、𝜏𝑚、𝜋𝑚、𝑑𝑚、𝑝𝑚、𝑒𝑚 连同 dom(𝐹𝛾)——除经定义 47 的原语外没有任何 Ψ𝑡 写入它们。当两个状态除控制字段外一切一致时写作 𝛾 ≈ 𝛿。关系 ≈ 不是定义 33 的 ≃，二者互不精化，因为各自遗忘对方所须保持者。恢复精确性是关于效应的断言，故 ≈ 精确比较表与环境状态，而只遗忘注册表关于哪个 fiber 安装它们的记录。

pairs.en: A rule reads the control fields to decide whether it applies, so ≃ has to keep them, and this section reads it as the conjunction of Definition  33 with agreement on the registry’s domain and on every control field of every fiber: 𝛾 ≃ 𝛿 ≔ 𝜎𝛾 ≃ 𝜎𝛿 ∧ dom(𝐹𝛾) = dom(𝐹𝛿) ∧ ∀𝑛, 𝑐 ∈ {𝜃, 𝜏, 𝜋, 𝑑, 𝑝, 𝑒}. 𝑐(𝛾(𝑛)) ≃ 𝑐(𝛿(𝑛))(53) A field of function type, as 𝑒𝑛 and the 𝑔 inside 𝜃𝑛 are, is compared as Definition 36 compares maps, an iterator as Definition 51 compares two, and a field of any other type by equality. The results below hold up to both relations, one for each half of the state, Lemma 55 establishing the ≃ half once for all ten rules. Table 1 is the ten rules of Section 4.3 read as such writes. The accumulator, the committed view, and the remaining iterator are constituents of 𝜃𝑛, so the third column records the writes to them as well, and ℎ there names the inverse the iteration of the fourth column yields, idΓ where L-Divert aborts that iteration.
pairs.zh: 规则读取控制字段以决定是否适用，故 ≃ 必须保持它们；本节将其读作定义 33 与注册表定义域以及每个 fiber 的每个控制字段上一致的合取：𝛾 ≃ 𝛿 ≔ 𝜎𝛾 ≃ 𝜎𝛿 ∧ dom(𝐹𝛾) = dom(𝐹𝛿) ∧ ∀𝑛, 𝑐 ∈ {𝜃, 𝜏, 𝜋, 𝑑, 𝑝, 𝑒}. 𝑐(𝛾(𝑛)) ≃ 𝑐(𝛿(𝑛)) (53) 函数类型的字段，如 𝑒𝑛 与 𝜃𝑛 内的 𝑔，按定义 36 比较映射；迭代器按定义 51 比较二者；任何其他类型的字段按相等比较。下文结果在两个关系上都成立，状态的每一半各一，引理 55 一次性为全部十条规则确立 ≃ 一半。表 1 是第 4.3 节的十条规则按此种写入解读。累加器、已提交视图与剩余迭代器是 𝜃𝑛 的成分，故第三列也记录对它们的写入，那里的 ℎ 命名第四列迭代所给出的逆，在 L-Divert 中止该迭代处为 idΓ。

pairs.en: Proof. Let step 𝑡 apply 𝑟 at 𝑛. By Definition 53 it factors as edit𝑡 ∘ Ψ𝑡, where edit𝑡 writes the fields the fifth column of Table 1 names and nothing else, and Ψ𝑡 is idΓ, an application of one of 𝑛’s iterations, or the accumulator 𝑔𝑡 𝑛, which is a composite of the inverses those iterations yielded. Each of the three is confined to 𝑛 by Definition 48, so Ψ𝑡 writes no field of a fiber present at 𝛾𝑡 but 𝜎𝑛, together with the entry a registration adds and the 𝜏 its inverse writes. The two halves therefore partition the writes, and each clause is that partition read at one field. One reading of the second and third columns is used twice: 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 is the one lifecycle state carrying no committed view, L-Begin the one rule leading out of it, and L-Unload the one rule leading into it, while every other row carries the 𝜔 of its premise into its conclusion unchanged. (1) An edit𝑡 writes no table, the fifth column naming none, and a Ψ𝑡 writes no 𝜎𝑚 for a present 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛.
pairs.zh: 证明。设步骤 𝑡 在 𝑛 处应用 𝑟。由定义 53 它分解为 edit𝑡 ∘ Ψ𝑡，其中 edit𝑡 写入表 1 第五列所命名的字段且别无其他，而 Ψ𝑡 是 idΓ、𝑛 某次迭代的应用，或累加器 𝑔𝑡 𝑛——那些迭代所给出逆的复合。由定义 48 三者都约束于 𝑛，故 Ψ𝑡 除 𝜎𝑛 外不写入 𝛾𝑡 处出现的 fiber 的任何字段，连同注册所添加的条目及其逆所写的 𝜏。因此两半划分写入，每个条款是该划分在一个字段上的解读。第二列与第三列的一种解读被用两次：𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 是不携带已提交视图的唯一生命周期状态，L-Begin 是离开它的唯一规则，L-Unload 是进入它的唯一规则，而其他每行都将前提的 𝜔 不变地带入结论。(1) edit𝑡 不写入表，第五列不命名任何表，且 Ψ𝑡 不为出现的 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 写入任何 𝜎𝑚。

pairs.en: So 𝜎𝑚 can move only at 𝑚 = 𝑛, and only inside Ψ𝑡. (2) 𝜔𝑛 is a constituent of 𝜃𝑛, which only an edit𝑡 writes and only at the fiber the step acts on, so by the reading above 𝜔𝑛 comes into existence at an L-Begin of 𝑛 and ceases at an L-Unload of 𝑛. An episode of 𝑛 is an interval on which installed𝑛 holds, hence one throughout which 𝜔𝑛 is defined, so neither rule falls in its interior. (3) The fourth column, where an accumulator appears at L-Unload alone: the other rules take a forward map pr1 ∘ 𝑖 or idΓ, and no edit𝑡 applies a map to the state at all. (4) installed𝑛 is 𝜃𝑛 ≠ 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−), and by the reading above L-Begin and L-Unload are the only rules whose premise and conclusion differ in whether 𝜃𝑛 is 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾. A step acting on some 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 writes no 𝜃𝑛, and the entry a registration adds is at a name not present at 𝛾𝑡. (5) No row of the fifth column names a 𝜋, 𝑑, 𝑝, or 𝑒;
pairs.zh: 故 𝜎𝑚 仅能在 𝑚 = 𝑛 处移动，且仅在 Ψ𝑡 内。(2) 𝜔𝑛 是 𝜃𝑛 的成分，只有 edit𝑡 写入它且仅在步骤所作用的 fiber 处，故由上述解读，𝜔𝑛 在 𝑛 的 L-Begin 处产生并在 𝑛 的 L-Unload 处消失。𝑛 的插曲是 installed𝑛 成立的区间，因而 𝜔𝑛 在其中始终有定义，故两条规则都不落在其内部。(3) 第四列，累加器仅出现在 L-Unload：其他规则取前向映射 pr1 ∘ 𝑖 或 idΓ，且没有任何 edit𝑡 将映射应用于状态。(4) installed𝑛 是 𝜃𝑛 ≠ 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−)，由上述解读，L-Begin 与 L-Unload 是前提与结论在 𝜃𝑛 是否为 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 上不同的唯一规则。作用于某个 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 的步骤不写入 𝜃𝑛，注册所添加的条目在 𝛾𝑡 处不出现的名字处。(5) 第五列没有任何一行命名 𝜋、𝑑、𝑝 或 𝑒；

Only ORetire writes a 𝜏, at ⊤, whether taken by the orchestrator or as the inverse of a registration (Definition 47); O-Insert sets 𝜏 = ⊥ at a name not already present, so no step returns a 𝜏 to ⊥.□ Three further lookups say what the rules cannot see. The first is that they read the state only through the observations above, so that the whole calculus descends to Γ/ ≃.

pairs.en: Proof. Every premise of Section 4.3 is of one of four kinds, and each reads a constituent the relation keeps. A premise matching 𝜃𝑛 or 𝜏𝑛 against a pattern, and the premise ∀𝑚. 𝜋𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 of O-Remove, read control fields. The premises (𝑑, 𝑝, 𝑒) ∈ ℭΓ and ∀𝑚. 𝑝 ∩ 𝑝𝑚 = ⌀ of O-Insert read 𝑑, 𝑝, and 𝑒. A premise mentioning target𝑛 or relied𝑛 reads 𝜏𝑛, the committed views inside the 𝜃𝑚, and dom(𝜎𝛾), which Definition 45 computes from the 𝜃𝑚 and the dom(𝜎𝑚), and Definition 33 relates two coeffect contexts only where their domains agree. The remaining premises read dom(𝐹𝛾). None reads a value 𝜎𝛾(𝑘) otherwise than up to ≃𝑘 , so no premise separates two ≃-related states. For the conclusion, 𝛾𝑡+1 = edit𝑡(Ψ𝑡(𝛾𝑡)) by Definition 53. The values an edit𝑡 assigns are the constituents of the premises it matched, related at the two states by the paragraph above and by Definition 51, which relates the triples an iterator yields at ≃-related states.
pairs.zh: 证明。第 4.3 节的每个前提属于四种之一，每种都读取关系所保持的成分。将 𝜃𝑛 或 𝜏𝑛 与模式匹配的前提，以及 O-Remove 的前提 ∀𝑚. 𝜋𝑚 ≠ 𝑛，读取控制字段。O-Insert 的前提 (𝑑, 𝑝, 𝑒) ∈ ℭΓ 与 ∀𝑚. 𝑝 ∩ 𝑝𝑚 = ⌀ 读取 𝑑、𝑝 与 𝑒。提及 target𝑛 或 relied𝑛 的前提读取 𝜏𝑛、𝜃𝑚 内的已提交视图，以及 dom(𝜎𝛾)，定义 45 从 𝜃𝑚 与 dom(𝜎𝑚) 计算后者，而定义 33 仅在定义域一致时关联两个共效应上下文。其余前提读取 dom(𝐹𝛾)。没有任何前提以超出 ≃𝑘 的方式读取值 𝜎𝛾(𝑘)，故没有任何前提分离两个 ≃-相关的状态。对结论，由定义 53，𝛾𝑡+1 = edit𝑡(Ψ𝑡(𝛾𝑡))。edit𝑡 所赋的值是其所匹配前提的成分，在两状态由上一段以及定义 51 相关，后者在 ≃-相关状态处关联迭代器所给出的三元组。

pairs.en: And Ψ𝑡 respects ≃: it is idΓ, or an iteration of 𝑒𝑛, which Definition 51 requires to respect ≃, or the accumulator inside 𝜃𝑛, a composite of inverses each respecting ≃ by the same definition. □ The names a state carries are read by two of those observations, dom(𝐹𝛾) and the indexing of the control fields, and the rule that draws a name draws any name not already in use (Definition 47). Reading the results below up to ≃ therefore also calls for reading them up to a renaming, which is the discipline of Section 4.1 cashed out.
pairs.zh: 且 Ψ𝑡 尊重 ≃：它是 idΓ，或 𝑒𝑛 的一次迭代——定义 51 要求其尊重 ≃——或 𝜃𝑛 内的累加器，由同一定义每个逆都尊重 ≃ 的复合。□ 状态所携带的名字由那些观察中的两个读取，dom(𝐹𝛾) 与控制字段的索引，而取名字的规则取任何尚未使用的名字（定义 47）。因此将下文结果按 ≃ 解读也要求按重命名解读，这是第 4.1 节纪律的兑现。

pairs.zh: 注册表 𝐹𝛾 ∘ 𝜒−1 的状态，其中出现在 𝜋𝑚 或 𝜔𝑚 中的每个名字都由其像替换。则 𝜒 ⋅ 𝛾 是状态，在 𝛾 良构处良构，且 step𝑡 = 𝑟(𝑛) 将 𝛾𝑡 带到 𝛾𝑡+1 当且仅当 𝑟(𝜒(𝑛)) 将 𝜒 ⋅ 𝛾𝑡 带到 𝜒 ⋅ 𝛾𝑡+1。

pairs.en: Proof. A premise reads a name only by comparing it with another, whether directly, as in the freshness 𝑛 ∉ dom(𝐹𝛾) of O-Insert and the ∀𝑚. 𝜋𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 of O-Remove, or through a table of names, as target𝑛 and relied𝑛 read the 𝜋𝑚 and the 𝜔𝑚. A bijection preserves each such comparison. The only names a rule writes are the 𝜋 that O-Insert sets and the 𝜔 that L-Begin sets, both taken from what its premises read, so the writes commute with 𝜒; an effect function writes no name at all, drawing one only through the primitive of Definition 47, which Definition 48 confines to the entry that primitive adds. Well-formedness ( Definition 58) is four conditions comparing names with names. □ A sequence and its renaming therefore take the same rules in the same order and reach states differing by 𝜒 alone. Two sequences agreeing save in the names their registrations draw are accordingly identified, and the results below are read up to the renaming that identifies them.
pairs.zh: 证明。前提仅通过将名字与另一名字比较来读取名字，无论是直接比较——如 O-Insert 的新鲜性 𝑛 ∉ dom(𝐹𝛾) 与 O-Remove 的 ∀𝑚. 𝜋𝑚 ≠ 𝑛——还是通过名字表——如 target𝑛 与 relied𝑛 读取 𝜋𝑚 与 𝜔𝑚。双射保持每一次此种比较。规则所写的唯一名字是 O-Insert 所设的 𝜋 与 L-Begin 所设的 𝜔，二者都取自其前提所读者，故写入与 𝜒 交换；效应函数根本不写名字，仅经定义 47 的原语取一个，而定义 48 将其约束于该原语所添加的条目。良构性（定义 58）是四个比较名字与名字的条件。□ 因此序列及其重命名按相同顺序取相同规则，并到达仅差 𝜒 的状态。除其注册所取名字外一致的两个序列因而被等同，下文结果按等同它们的重命名解读。

pairs.en: Proof. A vestigial 𝑛 contributes to no observation a premise of a rule acting on 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 reads. It is not 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾, so 𝜎𝑛 enters no 𝜎𝛾 and 𝑛 is the provider of no key, leaving 𝛾 ⊧ 𝑑𝑚 and target𝑚 unmoved; installed𝑛 fails, so 𝑛 contributes no disjunct to relied𝑚; no 𝜋𝑚′ names 𝑛, so the premise ∀𝑚′. 𝜋𝑚′ ≠ 𝑚 of an O-Remove of 𝑚 is unmoved; and 𝜃𝑛, 𝜏𝑛, and 𝜋𝑛 are read by rules acting on 𝑛 alone. The two premises clause (2) excepts are the two the removal relaxes, an absent name being fresh and an absent provision meeting every other. By Lemma 54 no rule acting on 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 writes a field of 𝑛, so the entry survives, and the state map of the step is confined to 𝑚 by Definition 48, so it leaves 𝜎𝑛 empty. □ Simplifying the lifecycle states, together with the rules that match on them, yields a subcalculus, and not every result survives the simplification.
pairs.zh: 证明。残余的 𝑛 对作用于 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 的规则之前提所读的任何观察都无贡献。它不是 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾，故 𝜎𝑛 不进入任何 𝜎𝛾，𝑛 不是任何键的提供者，留下 𝛾 ⊧ 𝑑𝑚 与 target𝑚 不动；installed𝑛 失败，故 𝑛 不对 relied𝑚 贡献任何析取；没有任何 𝜋𝑚′ 命名 𝑛，故对 𝑚 的 O-Remove 的前提 ∀𝑚′. 𝜋𝑚′ ≠ 𝑚 不动；而 𝜃𝑛、𝜏𝑛 与 𝜋𝑛 仅由作用于 𝑛 的规则读取。条款 (2) 所例外的两个前提正是移除所放宽的两个，缺席名字新鲜且缺席提供与其他每个相交为空。由引理 54，作用于 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 的规则不写入 𝑛 的任何字段，故条目幸存；且由定义 48 该步的状态映射约束于 𝑚，故留下 𝜎𝑛 为空。□ 简化生命周期状态连同匹配它们的规则得到子演算，并非每个结果都在简化下幸存。

pairs.en: Dropping Section 4.3.1 is the case that matters, which is the division Section 4.3 opens with, read from the metatheory’s side: its guard is what establishes clauses (3) and (4) of Definition 58, and Theorem 63 rests on the interval the guard creates, so those three fail without it. What the other three subsections add can be simplified away without disturbing the results below, each of them only adding rules to the one state space Definition 49 fixes.
pairs.zh: 丢掉第 4.3.1 节是要紧的情形，这是第 4.3 节开篇的划分，从元理论一侧解读：其守卫确立定义 58 的条款 (3) 与 (4)，定理 63 依赖守卫所创造的区间，故没有它这三者失败。其他三个小节所添加者可被简化掉而不扰动下文结果，它们各自只向定义 49 所固定的同一状态空间添加规则。

pairs.en: 4.4.1. Preservation
Definition 45 fixes the shape of a registry, and the rules have to be checked against it before the
pairs.zh: 定义 45 固定了注册表的形状，在下文结果对其添加内容之前，须先对照该形状检查规则。

pairs.en: results below can add to it. This subsection identifies the invariant the rules preserve, of which the first clause is that shape and the rest what those results assume.
pairs.zh: 本小节识别规则所保持的不变式，其中第一款即是该形状，其余是那些结果所假定者。

pairs.en: Definition 58. A registry 𝐹𝛾 is well formed when, for all 𝑚, 𝑛 ∈ dom(𝐹𝛾) and all 𝑘 ∈ 𝐾,
pairs.zh: 定义 58. 注册表 𝐹𝛾 良构，当且仅当对所有 𝑚, 𝑛 ∈ dom(𝐹𝛾) 与所有 𝑘 ∈ 𝐾，

pairs.en: 1. 𝜋𝑛 ∈ dom(𝐹𝛾) ∪ {𝗋𝗈𝗈𝗍};
pairs.zh: 1. 𝜋𝑛 ∈ dom(𝐹𝛾) ∪ {𝗋𝗈𝗈𝗍}；

pairs.en: 2. 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 ⇒ 𝑝𝑚 ∩ 𝑝𝑛 = ⌀;
pairs.zh: 2. 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 ⇒ 𝑝𝑚 ∩ 𝑝𝑛 = ⌀；

pairs.en: 3. installed𝑛(𝛾) ⇒ 𝜔𝑛 is total on 𝑑𝑛 and valued in dom(𝐹𝛾);
pairs.zh: 3. installed𝑛(𝛾) ⇒ 𝜔𝑛 在 𝑑𝑛 上全且取值于 dom(𝐹𝛾)；

pairs.en: 4. installed𝑛(𝛾) ∧ 𝑘 ∈ 𝑑𝑛 ∧ 𝜔𝑛(𝑘) = 𝑚 ⇒ installed𝑚(𝛾).
pairs.zh: 4. installed𝑛(𝛾) ∧ 𝑘 ∈ 𝑑𝑛 ∧ 𝜔𝑛(𝑘) = 𝑚 ⇒ installed𝑚(𝛾)。

pairs.en: Clause (1) is the tree of Definition 45 read one edge at a time, keeping a parent pointer landing in the registry. The acyclicity that definition also requires needs no clause, since the fiber a pointer names is registered before the fiber naming it.
pairs.zh: 条款 (1) 是定义 45 的树逐边解读，保持父指针落在注册表中。该定义亦要求的无环性无需条款，因为指针所命名的 fiber 在命名它的 fiber 之前注册。

pairs.en: Theorem 59. (Preservation.) If 𝐹𝑡 is well formed then so is 𝐹𝑡+1, whichever rule step 𝑡 applies.
pairs.zh: 定理 59.（保持性。）若 𝐹𝑡 良构，则无论步骤 𝑡 应用哪条规则，𝐹𝑡+1 亦良构。

pairs.en: Each clause is established at 𝛾𝑡+1 from all four at 𝛾𝑡.
pairs.zh: 每一条款都从 𝛾𝑡 处的全部四款确立于 𝛾𝑡+1。

pairs.en: Proof. Let step 𝑡 act on 𝑛. (1) By Table 1 only O-Insert and O-Remove write a 𝜋 or dom(𝐹𝛾). O-Insert has 𝜋𝑛 ∈ dom(𝐹𝑡) ∪ {𝗋𝗈𝗈𝗍} as a premise, which is the clause for the fiber it adds, and it leaves every other 𝜋 alone while enlarging dom(𝐹𝛾). O-Remove has ∀𝑚. 𝜋𝑚 ≠ 𝑛, so no surviving 𝜋𝑚 names the fiber it takes away. (2) The last premise of O-Insert is ∀𝑚. 𝑝𝑛 ∩ 𝑝𝑚 = ⌀, which is the clause for the fiber it adds, and by Table 1 no other rule writes a 𝑝 or enlarges dom(𝐹𝛾). Two consequences are used below: dom(𝜎𝑚) ⊆ 𝑝𝑚 by Definition 43, so distinct tables are disjoint and 𝜎𝛾 is a function; and 𝑘 ∈ 𝑝𝑚 ∩ 𝑝𝑚′ forces 𝑚 = 𝑚′, so 𝑘 has at most one possible provider. (3) By Lemma 54(2) the only rule that writes an 𝜔𝑛 is L-Begin, whose premise 𝜔 = target𝑡 𝑛 ≠ ⊥ makes it total on 𝑑𝑛 and valued in dom(𝐹𝑡), target naming providers.
pairs.zh: 证明。设步骤 𝑡 作用于 𝑛。(1) 由表 1，只有 O-Insert 与 O-Remove 写入 𝜋 或 dom(𝐹𝛾)。O-Insert 以 𝜋𝑛 ∈ dom(𝐹𝑡) ∪ {𝗋𝗈𝗈𝗍} 为前提，这正是其所添加 fiber 的条款，且在扩大 dom(𝐹𝛾) 的同时保持其余每个 𝜋 不变。O-Remove 有 ∀𝑚. 𝜋𝑚 ≠ 𝑛，故没有幸存的 𝜋𝑚 命名其所取走的 fiber。(2) O-Insert 的最后前提是 ∀𝑚. 𝑝𝑛 ∩ 𝑝𝑚 = ⌀，这正是其所添加 fiber 的条款，且由表 1 没有其他规则写入 𝑝 或扩大 dom(𝐹𝛾)。下文使用两个推论：由定义 43，dom(𝜎𝑚) ⊆ 𝑝𝑚，故不同表不相交且 𝜎𝛾 是函数；而 𝑘 ∈ 𝑝𝑚 ∩ 𝑝𝑚′ 迫使 𝑚 = 𝑚′，故 𝑘 至多有一个可能的提供者。(3) 由引理 54(2)，唯一写入 𝜔𝑛 的规则是 L-Begin，其前提 𝜔 = target𝑡 𝑛 ≠ ⊥ 使其在 𝑑𝑛 上全且取值于 dom(𝐹𝑡)，因为 target 命名提供者。

pairs.en: By Table 1 the only rule that shrinks dom(𝐹𝛾) is O-Remove, whose premise 𝜃𝑡 𝑛 = 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−) gives ¬ installed𝑡 𝑛, whence by clause (4) at 𝛾𝑡 no 𝑚 has 𝜔𝑡 𝑚(𝑘) = 𝑛 for a 𝑘 ∈ 𝑑𝑚 while installed𝑡 𝑚; and 𝑛 itself carries no 𝜔. (4) By Lemma 54(2) and (4) the clause can fail at 𝛾𝑡+1 only where some installed has fallen, some 𝜔 has been written, or a fiber some 𝜔 names has left dom(𝐹𝛾). The last is an O-Remove, whose removed fiber is not installed and hence, by clause (4) at 𝛾𝑡, is named by no 𝜔𝑡 𝑚 of an installed 𝑚. The first is an L-Unload of 𝑛, whose premise ¬ relied𝑡 𝑛 reads ∀𝑚 ≠ 𝑛, 𝑘 ∈ 𝑑𝑚. installed𝑡 𝑚 ⇒ 𝜔𝑡 𝑚(𝑘) ≠ 𝑛 and which writes no 𝜔𝑚 for 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 and leaves ¬ installed𝑡+1 𝑛 , so the clause holds of 𝑛 as well. The second is an L-Begin of 𝑛, writing target𝑡 𝑛, whose values are the providers of the keys of 𝑑𝑛 and hence 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 at 𝛾𝑡; the step alters no other fiber’s 𝜃, so they are installed at 𝛾𝑡+1 too. □ The guard on L-Unload is what carries clauses (3) and (4). The premise ∀𝑚.
pairs.zh: 由表 1，唯一缩小 dom(𝐹𝛾) 的规则是 O-Remove，其前提 𝜃𝑡 𝑛 = 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−) 给出 ¬ installed𝑡 𝑛，于是由 𝛾𝑡 处的条款 (4)，没有任何 𝑚 在 installed𝑡 𝑚 时有 𝜔𝑡 𝑚(𝑘) = 𝑛（𝑘 ∈ 𝑑𝑚）；且 𝑛 本身不携带 𝜔。(4) 由引理 54(2) 与 (4)，该条款在 𝛾𝑡+1 处仅可能在某个已安装者落下、某个 𝜔 被写入、或某个 𝜔 所命名的 fiber 离开 dom(𝐹𝛾) 时失败。最后一种是 O-Remove，其被移除的 fiber 未安装，故由 𝛾𝑡 处的条款 (4)，不被任何已安装 𝑚 的 𝜔𝑡 𝑚 命名。第一种是 𝑛 的 L-Unload，其前提 ¬ relied𝑡 𝑛 读作 ∀𝑚 ≠ 𝑛, 𝑘 ∈ 𝑑𝑚. installed𝑡 𝑚 ⇒ 𝜔𝑡 𝑚(𝑘) ≠ 𝑛，且不为 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 写入任何 𝜔𝑚，并留下 ¬ installed𝑡+1 𝑛，故该条款对 𝑛 亦成立。第二种是 𝑛 的 L-Begin，写入 target𝑡 𝑛，其值是 𝑑𝑛 之键的提供者，故在 𝛾𝑡 处为 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾；该步不改变任何其他 fiber 的 𝜃，故它们在 𝛾𝑡+1 处亦已安装。□ L-Unload 上的守卫正是承载条款 (3) 与 (4) 者。前提 ∀𝑚.

pairs.en: 𝜋𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 of ORemove speaks only of parent pointers; what keeps a committed view from naming a removed fiber is the guard, imposed several steps earlier and for a different reason. Because a failure is routed through 𝖴𝗇𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀 as well, the argument does not have to be repeated for an error outcome. Two things follow that the base calculus does not enjoy. A name freed by O-Remove may be reissued by O-Insert, since no stale committed view can name it; and a fiber may be removed as soon as it is 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾, without a separate check that nobody depends on it.
pairs.zh: 𝜋𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 的 O-Remove 只谈父指针；使已提交视图不命名已移除 fiber 的是守卫，它在若干步之前出于不同理由施加。因为失败也经 𝖴𝗇𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀 路由，论证无需对错误结果重复。随之而来的是基本演算所不享有的两点。O-Remove 所释放的名字可由 O-Insert 重新发放，因为没有陈旧的已提交视图能命名它；且 fiber 一旦为 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 即可移除，无需另行检查无人依赖它。

pairs.en: 4.4.2. Temporal Composability
pairs.zh: 4.4.2. 时间可复合性

pairs.en: Local temporal composability recovers one sequence of effects with one accumulator ( Section 3.1.3). The registry holds one accumulator per fiber and the fibers interleave: between the moment 𝑛 composes an inverse onto 𝑔𝑛 and the moment 𝑔𝑛 runs, other fibers have moved the state. Whether 𝑔𝑛 still undoes what it was built to undo there is what the global form of the guarantee asserts, and the condition it turns on is that the intervening steps commute with 𝑔𝑛.
pairs.zh: 局部时间可复合性以一个累加器恢复一串效应（第 3.1.3 节）。注册表为每个 fiber 持有一个累加器，且 fiber 交织：在 𝑛 将逆复合到 𝑔𝑛 的时刻与 𝑔𝑛 运行的时刻之间，其他 fiber 已移动状态。𝑔𝑛 在那里是否仍撤销其被构建所要撤销者，正是该保证的全局形式所断言者，而其依赖的条件是介入步骤与 𝑔𝑛 交换。

Independence in this sense is what trace theory takes as primitive: commuting actions generate an equivalence on sequences under which reordering two adjacent independent actions preserves the endpoint [44], and Lemma 71 is that reordering for these rules.

pairs.en: A family rather than a set is what keeps two names of one component in scope: the condition then requires that component’s effect function to be independent of itself, which is to require that 𝔐(𝑖) be commutative. The first condition is what Theorem 61 uses and the second what Theorem 73 needs in addition: reordering the steps of two fibers evaluates an iterator at a state the other fiber moved, and commuting the maps does not by itself say that the iterator yields the same inverse and the same continuation there. Checking the first condition calls for no more than the iterations themselves, since Lemma 18(1) carries commutation from the generators to the monoids they generate. Under these conditions the single-accumulator invariant of Theorem  7 survives the interleaving, in the form that gives temporal composability its content: running an inverse withdraws the fiber’s contribution and nothing else.
pairs.zh: 族而非集合正是使同一组件的两个名字保持在作用域内：此时条件要求该组件的效应函数与自身独立，亦即要求 𝔐(𝑖) 交换。第一条件是定理 61 所用者，第二条件是定理 73 额外所需者：重排两个 fiber 的步骤会在另一 fiber 所移动的状态上求值迭代器，而映射交换本身并不说明迭代器在那里给出相同的逆与相同的延续。检验第一条件只需迭代本身，因为引理 18(1) 将交换从生成元带到它们所生成的幺半群。在这些条件下，定理 7 的单累加器不变式在交织下幸存，其形式给出时间可复合性的内容：运行逆撤回该 fiber 的贡献且仅此而已。

Carrying that result from effect functions to iterators calls for nothing new, a coeffect-mediated effect function (Definition 41) already choosing what follows each stage by the outcome that stage yields, which is what an iterator carries in its continuation.

pairs.en: The coeffect operations of Section 3.2 are the case that needs no hypothesis at all: the maps a component contributes there are composites of set operations and of the corresponding restrictions, two such commute whenever they touch disjoint keys, and clause (2) of Definition 58 makes the provisions of distinct fibers disjoint.
pairs.zh: 第 3.2 节的共效应操作是完全无需假设的情形：组件在那里所贡献的映射是集合操作与相应限制的复合，二者在触及不相交键时交换，而定义 58 的条款 (2) 使不同 fiber 的提供不相交。

pairs.en: 4.4.3. Spatial Composability
pairs.zh: 4.4.3. 空间可复合性

pairs.en: Local spatial composability holds a component to its own specification, activating it only where its dependencies are provided and classifying every context change against them (Section 3.2.2). The global form adds what quantifies over other fibers: a provider withdraws a binding only after every dependent that resolved it has deactivated, and the resolution a transition installs its effects against does not shift under it. Two properties of the coeffect side deliver the two, and they are proved together, being two halves of one invariant, namely the fixity of 𝜔𝑛 over an episode that Lemma  54(2) establishes. The ordering theorem is what that fixity buys over the part of the episode in which 𝑛 is 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 and then 𝖴𝗇𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀, and the coherence theorem what it buys over the part in which 𝑛 is installing its effects.
pairs.zh: 局部空间可复合性使组件遵守其自有规约，仅在其依赖被提供处激活，并对照它们分类每一次上下文变更（第 3.2.2 节）。全局形式添加对其他 fiber 的量化：提供者仅在每个解析它的依赖方都已停用之后才撤回绑定，且转换安装其效应所对照的解析在其下不偏移。共效应侧的两个性质交付二者，它们一并证明，作为同一不变式的两半，亦即引理 54(2) 所确立的插曲上 𝜔𝑛 的固定性。排序定理是该固定性在 𝑛 为 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 然后为 𝖴𝗇𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀 的插曲部分上所换取者，而一致性定理是它在 𝑛 安装其效应的部分上所换取者。

pairs.en: Proof. The first claim is the premise target𝑡 𝑚 ≠ ⊥ of L-Begin, which by Definition 46 gives 𝛾𝑡 ⊧ 𝑑𝑚. (1) is Lemma 54(2). For (2), the L-Begin at 𝑏′ − 1 writes 𝜔𝑏′ 𝑚 = target𝑏′−1 𝑚 , whose values are providers, so 𝜃𝑏′ 𝑛 = 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−, −); the L-Begin at 𝑏 − 1 leaves 𝜃𝑏 𝑛 = 𝖱𝖾𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀(−, −, −), so 𝑏 ≠ 𝑏′ and hence 𝑏 < 𝑏′, both episodes opening by Definition 53. Let [𝑏, 𝑢] close and suppose 𝑢 ≤ 𝑢′. Then 𝑢 ∈ [𝑏′, 𝑢′], so installed𝑢 𝑚 and, by (1), 𝜔𝑢 𝑚(𝑘) = 𝑛; that is relied𝑢 𝑛, which the L-Unload at 𝑢 denies. Hence 𝑢′ < 𝑢. For (3), 𝑛 is the provider of 𝑘 at 𝛾𝑏′ , so 𝑘 ∈ dom(𝜎𝑏′ 𝑛 ). No L-Unload of 𝑛 falls in [𝑏′, 𝑢′]: where [𝑏, 𝑢] closes it falls at 𝑢 > 𝑢′ by (2), and where it does not, Lemma 54(4) leaves 𝑛 with no LUnload at all. Since 𝜃𝑏′ 𝑛 = 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−, −), Table 1 therefore leaves L-Leave as the only rule 𝑛 can be acted on by within [𝑏′, 𝑢′], and its Ψ𝑡 is idΓ; by Lemma 54(1) 𝜎𝑛 is constant there.

pairs.en: □ A transition spread over steps could otherwise install effects computed against a resolu - tion that has changed under it, and two premises prevent that. L-Iter and L-Finish carry target𝑛(𝛾) = 𝜔, so a transition proceeds only while its committed view is still its target view, and L-Divert carries the negation, so any change to the target view takes the fiber out of the transition. L-Raise is not conditioned on the target view at all, a raise being something the iteration does rather than something the environment asks for, and it exits the transition in any case. The two directions of change are not distinguished: a component whose dependency has gone and one whose dependency has been replaced leave by the same route, because a target view that has become ⊥ and one that has become some other fiber are equally unequal to 𝜔. Inertia is what stops this from being a guarantee about every step.
pairs.zh: □ 否则跨越步骤的转换可能安装对着其下已变的解析所计算的效应，而两个前提防止这一点。L-Iter 与 L-Finish 携带 target𝑛(𝛾) = 𝜔，故转换仅在其已提交视图仍是其目标视图时继续；L-Divert 携带其否定，故目标视图的任何变化都将 fiber 带出转换。L-Raise 完全不以目标视图为条件，因为引发是迭代所做之事而非环境所要求之事，且它无论如何都退出转换。变化的两个方向不加区分：依赖已离去的组件与依赖已被替换的组件经同一路径离开，因为变为 ⊥ 的目标视图与变为某个其他 fiber 的目标视图同样不等于 𝜔。惯性阻止这成为关于每一步的保证。

pairs.en: An iteration already in flight when the target view turns lands regardless, by L-Divert, and that landing installs an effect computed against a resolution that no longer holds. What the rules deliver is therefore a disjunction, and the second branch is what makes the first safe.
pairs.zh: 目标视图翻转时已在飞行中的迭代无论如何都会落地，由 L-Divert，而该落地安装对着不再成立的解析所计算的效应。因此规则所交付的是析取，而第二分支使第一分支安全。

pairs.en: Proof. The L-Begin at 𝑏 − 1 writes 𝖱𝖾𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀, and by Table 1 it is the one rule leading into that lifecycle state; its premise 𝜃𝑛 = 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(⊥) and Lemma 54(4) put any second application of it outside the episode. The first claim is then the premise target𝑛(𝛾) = 𝜔′ that Table  1 gives L-Iter and L-Finish, together with 𝜔′ = 𝜔 by Lemma 54(2). For the dichotomy, step𝑟 is a rule whose premise has 𝜃𝑛 = 𝖱𝖾𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀(−, −, −) and whose conclusion does not, of which Table 1 offers L-Finish, L-Divert, and L-Raise; the first lands in 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−, 𝜔) and the other two in 𝖴𝗇𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀(−, 𝜔, −), from which Lemma 54(4) makes an LUnload the only exit and Corollary 62 supplies the equation. pairs.en: an assumption and not something the definition delivers, 𝑛 ≺ 𝑛 holding of a component that declares a key it provides itself. What ≺ orders is the two fibers’ activations and not their lifetimes: 𝑛 ≺ 𝑚 says that 𝑛 has to become 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 before 𝑚 can, whereas that a provider outlives its consumer is Theorem 63(2), a theorem about the guarded calculus. A fiber’s target view answers to the fiber that created it as well as to its providers. What a creator writes is 𝜏𝑛, through the primitive of Definition 47, and 𝜏 is monotone by Lemma 54(5). A creator can therefore turn its child’s target view at most once over that child’s whole existence. Progress is a claim that some rule applies, so it is formulated over the rules a host must offer: L-Begin, L-Leave, L-Unload, the landing rules L-Iter, L-Finish, and L-Raise, and L-Divert. It appeals to the aborting alternative of L-Divert nowhere, so a host bound by the inertia of Section 4.3.3 is covered as well.

Were 𝑚𝑗+1 in 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 or 𝖱𝖾𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀 it would then be of one of the four kinds excluded, so it is in 𝖴𝗇𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀 and the construction continues. The 𝑚𝑗 are ≺-increasing, hence distinct by acyclicity, and dom(𝐹𝑡) is finite, so the construction stops. Termination. Two claims bound 𝑆(𝑛).
pairs.zh: • 𝜃𝑡 𝑛 = 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−, 𝜔𝑛) 且 target𝑡 𝑛 ≠ 𝜔𝑛：L-Leave 适用。设没有任何 fiber 属于这些种类，留下某个 𝑚0 有 𝜃𝑡 𝑚0 = 𝖴𝗇𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀(−, −, −)。如下构造 𝑚0, 𝑚1, …：给定处于 𝖴𝗇𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀 的 𝑚𝑗，要么 ¬ relied𝑡 𝑚𝑗，此时 L-Unload 适用于 𝑚𝑗 且构造停止；要么存在 𝑚𝑗+1 ≠ 𝑚𝑗 与 𝑘𝑗 使得 installed𝑡 𝑚𝑗+1 且 𝜔𝑡 𝑚𝑗+1 (𝑘𝑗) = 𝑚𝑗。在后一情形 𝑘𝑗 ∈ 𝑑𝑚𝑗+1 ∩ dom(𝜎𝑡 𝑚𝑗 ) ⊆ 𝑑𝑚𝑗+1 ∩ 𝑝𝑚𝑗，第二成员关系是定理 63(3) 在 𝑡 所落的 𝑚𝑗+1 插曲处，从而 𝑚𝑗 ≺ 𝑚𝑗+1。此外 target𝑡 𝑚𝑗+1 ≠ 𝜔𝑡 𝑚𝑗+1：𝖴𝗇𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀 fiber 在定义 𝜎𝛾 的并之外，故 𝛾𝑡 处的 𝑘𝑗 未被提供或由不同于 𝑚𝑗 的 fiber 提供。若 𝑚𝑗+1 处于 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 或 𝖱𝖾𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀，则它属于被排除的四种之一，故它处于 𝖴𝗇𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀 且构造继续。𝑚𝑗 是 ≺-递增的，故由无环性彼此不同，而 dom(𝐹𝑡) 有限，故构造停止。终止。两个断言界定 𝑆(𝑛)。

pairs.en: (A) Over a maximal interval on which target𝑡 𝑛 is constant at 𝜔∗, at most 𝐾 + 4 steps act on 𝑛. Reading the 𝜃𝑛 columns of Table 1, from 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−, 𝜔) with 𝜔 ≠ 𝜔∗ the fiber takes an L-Leave and an L-Unload and then, if 𝜔∗ ≠ ⊥, an L-Begin and at most len(𝑒𝑛) ≤ 𝐾 landings, plus a second L-Unload where the last landing is an L-Raise; from 𝖱𝖾𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀 against an 𝜔 ≠ 𝜔∗ it takes an LDivert in place of the L-Leave, and from any other state a suffix of that sequence. No further L-Divert or L-Leave falls in the interval, the 𝜔 that the L-Begin writes being target𝑡 𝑛 = 𝜔∗ itself, and at 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−, 𝜔∗), at 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(⊥) with 𝜔∗ = ⊥, and at 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(𝜉) no rule applies at all. (B) If target𝑡 𝑛 ≠ target𝑡+1 𝑛 and step 𝑡 acts on 𝑚, then either 𝑚 ≺ 𝑛 or step 𝑡 writes 𝜏𝑛. By
pairs.zh: (A) 在 target𝑡 𝑛 恒为 𝜔∗ 的极大区间上，至多 𝐾 + 4 步作用于 𝑛。读表 1 的 𝜃𝑛 列，从 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−, 𝜔) 且 𝜔 ≠ 𝜔∗，fiber 取一次 L-Leave 与一次 L-Unload，然后若 𝜔∗ ≠ ⊥，取一次 L-Begin 与至多 len(𝑒𝑛) ≤ 𝐾 次落地，并在最后落地为 L-Raise 时再加一次 L-Unload；从对着 𝜔 ≠ 𝜔∗ 的 𝖱𝖾𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀，它以 L-Divert 代替 L-Leave；从任何其他状态，取该序列的一个后缀。区间内不再落入进一步的 L-Divert 或 L-Leave，因为 L-Begin 所写的 𝜔 即是 target𝑡 𝑛 = 𝜔∗ 本身；而在 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−, 𝜔∗)、在 𝜔∗ = ⊥ 的 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(⊥) 以及在 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(𝜉) 处，根本没有任何规则适用。(B) 若 target𝑡 𝑛 ≠ target𝑡+1 𝑛 且步骤 𝑡 作用于 𝑚，则要么 𝑚 ≺ 𝑛，要么步骤 𝑡 写入 𝜏𝑛。由

pairs.en: Definition 46 the value of target𝑛 is a function of 𝜏𝑛 and of the tables of the providers of the
pairs.zh: 定义 46，target𝑛 的值是 𝜏𝑛 与 𝑑𝑛 之键的提供者的表的函数；

pairs.en: keys of 𝑑𝑛; a provider satisfies 𝑘 ∈ dom(𝜎𝑚) ∩ 𝑑𝑛 and hence 𝑚 ≺ 𝑛, and a table changes only at a step acting on its own fiber by Lemma 54(1). Acyclicity gives 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛 in the first case, and the monotonicity of Lemma 54(5) admits the second at one 𝑡 per fiber. By (A) the interval count bounds 𝑆(𝑛) as 𝑆(𝑛) ≤ (𝐾 + 4)(𝑉 (𝑛) + 1), and by (B) each turn of target𝑛 either consumes a step of a fiber strictly ≺-below 𝑛 or is the one turn 𝜏𝑛 affords, so 𝑉 (𝑛) ≤ 1 + ∑𝑚≺𝑛 𝑆(𝑚). Since ≺ is acyclic and 𝑁 is finite, the recursion 𝐵(𝑛) ≔ (𝐾 + 4)(2 + ∑ 𝑚≺𝑛 𝐵(𝑚)) is well founded and defines 𝐵 with 𝑆(𝑛) ≤ 𝐵(𝑛); hence 𝑉 (𝑛) is finite and ∑𝑛 𝑆(𝑛) ≤ ∑𝑛 𝐵(𝑛). By (1) a sequence that cannot be extended is quiescent. □ Finiteness of 𝑁 is assumed rather than derived, and one condition on the components delivers it.
pairs.zh: 提供者满足 𝑘 ∈ dom(𝜎𝑚) ∩ 𝑑𝑛 从而 𝑚 ≺ 𝑛，而由表仅在作用于其自有 fiber 的步骤处变更，由引理 54(1)。无环性在第一情形给出 𝑚 ≠ 𝑛，而引理 54(5) 的单调性在每个 fiber 的一个 𝑡 处接纳第二情形。由 (A)，区间计数将 𝑆(𝑛) 界定为 𝑆(𝑛) ≤ (𝐾 + 4)(𝑉 (𝑛) + 1)；由 (B)，target𝑛 的每次翻转要么消耗严格 ≺-低于 𝑛 的 fiber 的一步，要么是 𝜏𝑛 所允许的那一次翻转，故 𝑉 (𝑛) ≤ 1 + ∑𝑚≺𝑛 𝑆(𝑚)。由于 ≺ 无环且 𝑁 有限，递归 𝐵(𝑛) ≔ (𝐾 + 4)(2 + ∑ 𝑚≺𝑛 𝐵(𝑚)) 良基并定义满足 𝑆(𝑛) ≤ 𝐵(𝑛) 的 𝐵；故 𝑉 (𝑛) 有限且 ∑𝑛 𝑆(𝑛) ≤ ∑𝑛 𝐵(𝑛)。由 (1)，不能扩展的序列是静止的。□ 𝑁 的有限性是假定而非导出，而组件上的一个条件交付它。

pairs.en: The components a host holds are finitely many programs given before anything runs, so if no component can register, however indirectly, a fiber of a component that registers one of its own, the registrations form a tree of bounded depth, and len(𝑒𝑛) ≤ 𝐾 bounds its branching. What the assumption rules out is a component that registers instances of itself without bound. The target records the providing fiber rather than a boolean, and under the single-source discipline of Section 4.2 the two drive the same transitions, a key having one possible provider there. What the view buys is the vocabulary of the results above, Theorem 63 and Theorem 64 both speaking of the resolution a fiber activated against, and it is what makes those results survive the scoped resolution of Section  3.2.3, under which one key resolves to different providers in different realms and the provisions no longer force the view. The implementation carries that scoping and holds the view in fiber.committed (Section 5.1.3).
pairs.zh: 宿主所持的组件是运行前给定的有限多个程序，故若没有任何组件能——无论间接地——注册某个注册自有者的组件的 fiber，则注册形成有界深度的树，而 len(𝑒𝑛) ≤ 𝐾 界定其分支。该假定所排除的是无界注册自身实例的组件。目标记录提供 fiber 而非布尔值，且在第 4.2 节的单源纪律下二者驱动相同的转换，因为那里每个键只有一个可能的提供者。视图所换取的是上文结果的词汇，定理 63 与定理 64 都谈 fiber 激活所对照的解析；正是它使那些结果在第 3.2.3 节的作用域解析下幸存，在其下同一键在不同 realm 中解析到不同提供者，且提供不再强制视图。实现携带该作用域并将视图保存在 fiber.committed 中（第 5.1.3 节）。

pairs.en: 4.4.5. Confluence

The results so far are about individual fibers. The property that characterizes the system as a whole is that its dynamic history leaves no trace: whatever sequence of activations and deactivations a running system has been through, the state it quiesces at is the one the same insertions and retirements would have produced had each component that ends up active been loaded once, in dependency order, and none ever unloaded. The lifecycle relation is confluent, and the normal form it converges on is the statically assembled one. This is the analogue, for dynamic composition, of the consistency with a from-scratch evaluation that change propagation establishes for incremental computation [45]. The claim is about ⟶ alone. Orchestration steps are inputs, and two sequences given different inputs land in different places for no interesting reason;
pairs.zh: 至此结果关乎个别 fiber。刻画系统整体的性质是其动态历史不留痕迹：无论运行系统经历了怎样的激活与停用序列，它所静止于的状态，正是同样的插入与退役在每个最终活跃的组件按依赖顺序加载一次且从未卸载时所会产生的状态。生命周期关系合流，其所收敛的范式是静态组装者。这是动态复合之于增量计算中变更传播所确立的与从零求值一致性的类比 [45]。该断言只关乎 ⟶。编排步骤是输入，给定不同输入的两个序列落在不同位置并无有趣理由；

pairs.en: what is at issue is whether the lifecycle rules, which are nondeterministic in which fiber steps next and in which exit a 𝖱𝖾𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀 fiber takes, can be made to disagree. Three lemmas are needed first. The first fixes the set of fibers that end up 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 without reference to any sequence of steps, which is what makes it a function of the input rather than of the schedule.
pairs.zh: 所争论的是生命周期规则——在下一步哪个 fiber 行动以及 𝖱𝖾𝗅𝗈𝖺𝖽𝗂𝗇𝗀 fiber 取哪一出口上非确定性——是否能被弄得不一致。首先需要三个引理。第一个不参照任何步骤序列而固定最终为 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 的 fiber 集合，这正使其成为输入而非调度的函数。

pairs.en: Definition 67. A fiber is supported at 𝛾 when it is not retired, the fiber registering it is supported,
pairs.zh: 定义 67. Fiber 在 𝛾 处受支持，当它未被退役、注册它的 fiber 受支持，

pairs.en: and every key it declares is provided by a supported fiber. The support relation on dom(𝐹𝛾) is the union of the two relations those clauses read, 𝑚 ⊲ 𝑛 ≔ 𝑚 ≺ 𝑛 ∨ 𝜋𝑛 = 𝑚 (62) and where it is well founded (Lemma 68) we write 𝐴 for the support set, the fibers supported at 𝛾: 𝑛 ∈ 𝐴 ≔ ¬𝜏𝑛 ∧ (𝜋𝑛 = 𝗋𝗈𝗈𝗍 ∨ 𝜋𝑛 ∈ 𝐴) ∧ ∀𝑘 ∈ 𝑑𝑛. ∃𝑚 ∈ 𝐴. 𝑘 ∈ 𝑝𝑚 (63) where 𝜋𝑛 = 𝗋𝗈𝗈𝗍 marks a fiber the orchestrator inserted and 𝜋𝑛 otherwise the fiber whose activation registers 𝑛. The clauses read no field but 𝜏, 𝜋, 𝑑, 𝑝. Both halves relate a fiber to one immediately below it, a parent rather than an ancestor and a direct provider rather than a transitive one, since that is what the clauses read; where the results below want an order they take the transitive closure, whose minimal elements, maximal elements, and linearizations are those of ⊲. The clauses refer to 𝐴 itself, so the definition is a recursion along ⊲, and it is the following that makes it one with a solution.
pairs.zh: 且它所声明的每个键都由受支持的 fiber 提供。dom(𝐹𝛾) 上的支持关系是这些条款所读的两个关系之并，𝑚 ⊲ 𝑛 ≔ 𝑚 ≺ 𝑛 ∨ 𝜋𝑛 = 𝑚 (62)；当它良基时（引理 68），我们以 𝐴 记支持集，即在 𝛾 处受支持的 fiber：𝑛 ∈ 𝐴 ≔ ¬𝜏𝑛 ∧ (𝜋𝑛 = 𝗋𝗈𝗈𝗍 ∨ 𝜋𝑛 ∈ 𝐴) ∧ ∀𝑘 ∈ 𝑑𝑛. ∃𝑚 ∈ 𝐴. 𝑘 ∈ 𝑝𝑚 (63) 其中 𝜋𝑛 = 𝗋𝗈𝗈𝗍 标记编排器所插入的 fiber，否则 𝜋𝑛 是其激活注册 𝑛 的 fiber。条款只读字段 𝜏、𝜋、𝑑、𝑝。两半都将 fiber 关联到其正下方之一——父而非祖先，直接提供者而非传递提供者——因为这正是条款所读者；当下文结果需要序时，取传递闭包，其极小元、极大元与线性化即是 ⊲ 的那些。条款引用 𝐴 本身，故定义是沿 ⊲ 的递归，而下列使它成为有解的递归。

pairs.en: Lemma 68. (Support is well founded.) Let ≺ be acyclic and let 𝛾 be reached by a sequence of
pairs.zh: 引理 68.（支持良基。）设 ≺ 无环，并设 𝛾 由一串

pairs.en: steps. Then ⊲ is well founded, and 𝐴 is the one solution of Definition 67, a function of 𝜏, 𝜋, 𝑑, and 𝑝 alone.
pairs.zh: 步骤到达。则 ⊲ 良基，且 𝐴 是定义 67 的唯一解，仅为 𝜏、𝜋、𝑑 与 𝑝 的函数。

pairs.en: Proof. Order the names of dom(𝐹𝛾) by the index of the step that registered each, which Definition 53 supplies by starting the sequence at an empty registry. The parent half of ⊲ descends in that index: an O-Insert has 𝜋 ∈ dom(𝐹𝛾) as a premise, so a parent pointer names a fiber registered earlier, and iterating it reaches the whole ancestry of a name in finitely many steps. A cycle therefore has to use ≺, and since ≺ is acyclic it has to mix the two, which needs some 𝑚 to declare a key that a fiber of 𝑚’s own subtree may provide. Such a fiber is registered by an activation of 𝑚 or of one of 𝑚’s descendants, hence at a step after the L-Begin of 𝑚; that L-Begin has 𝛾 ⊧ 𝑑𝑚 as a premise, so a fiber providing the key is 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 already before it, and clause (2) of Definition 58 leaves the key no second possible provider. The fiber that would close the cycle is therefore never registered, and the edge is absent from dom(𝐹𝛾).
pairs.zh: 证明。按注册每个名字的步骤下标为 dom(𝐹𝛾) 的名字排序，定义 53 通过从空注册表开始序列提供该下标。⊲ 的父一半在该下标中下降：O-Insert 以 𝜋 ∈ dom(𝐹𝛾) 为前提，故父指针命名更早注册的 fiber，迭代之在有限步内到达名字的全部祖先。因此环必须使用 ≺，而由于 ≺ 无环，它必须混合二者，这需要某个 𝑚 声明其自有子树中的 fiber 可能提供的键。这样的 fiber 由 𝑚 或其某个后代的激活注册，故在 𝑚 的 L-Begin 之后的步骤；该 L-Begin 以 𝛾 ⊧ 𝑑𝑚 为前提，故提供该键的 fiber 在其之前已为 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾，而定义 58 的条款 (2) 使该键没有第二个可能的提供者。因此会闭合环的 fiber 从不被注册，该边不在 dom(𝐹𝛾) 中。

pairs.en: A well-founded recursion has one solution, and the clauses read the four fields alone. □ The last clause reads 𝑝, the keys a component may provide, whereas the target reads dom(𝜎𝛾), the keys its fibers have installed, and Definition 43 relates the two by dom(𝜎𝑛) ⊆ 𝑝𝑛 alone. The support set therefore over-approximates the 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 fibers in general, and the condition that closes the gap is the following.
pairs.zh: 良基递归有唯一解，且条款只读这四个字段。□ 最后条款读 𝑝——组件可提供的键——而目标读 dom(𝜎𝛾)——其 fiber 已安装的键，定义 43 仅以 dom(𝜎𝑛) ⊆ 𝑝𝑛 关联二者。因此支持集一般高估 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 fiber，而弥合差距的条件如下。

pairs.en: Definition 69. A component (𝑑, 𝑝, 𝑒) is total on its provision when an activation of it that finishes
pairs.zh: 定义 69. 组件 (𝑑, 𝑝, 𝑒) 在其提供上是完全的，当一次完成的激活

pairs.en: has installed every key of 𝑝, so that dom(𝜎𝑛) = 𝑝𝑛 at every 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 fiber instantiating it. Like independence (Definition 60) this is a condition on the components alone, mentioning no lifecycle state and no step, and independence already bounds how far it can fail: were a component to install a key only at context states another component’s effects reach, its forward map would not commute with that component’s, so the keys a fiber installs are fixed by its component rather than by the schedule. What totality adds is that the fixed set is all of 𝑝 rather than a proper subset of it.
pairs.zh: 已安装 𝑝 的每个键，从而使实例化它的每个 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 fiber 都有 dom(𝜎𝑛) = 𝑝𝑛。像独立性（定义 60）一样，这是仅关于组件的条件，不提及生命周期状态也不提及步骤；独立性已界定它能失败到多远：若组件仅在另一组件的效应所达的上下文状态安装键，则其前向映射不会与该组件交换，故 fiber 所安装的键由其组件而非由调度固定。完全性所添加的是固定集合是全部 𝑝 而非其真子集。

pairs.en: Lemma 70. (Support at quiescence.) Let ≺ be acyclic, let quiet(𝛾), let no fiber of 𝛾 be failed,
pairs.zh: 引理 70.（静止处的支持。）设 ≺ 无环，设 quiet(𝛾)，设 𝛾 没有失败的 fiber，

pairs.en: and let every component of 𝛾 be total on its provision (Definition 69). Then the support set is the set of 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 fibers: 𝐴 = {𝑛 : 𝜃𝑛 = 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−, −)} (64)
pairs.zh: 并设 𝛾 的每个组件在其提供上完全（定义 69）。则支持集即是 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 fiber 的集合：𝐴 = {𝑛 : 𝜃𝑛 = 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(−, −)} (64)

pairs.en: Proof. Write 𝐴′ for the right-hand side. No fiber being failed, the quiet of Definition 49 leaves 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(⊥) and 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 as the only states and reads 𝑛 ∈ 𝐴′ ⟺ target𝑛(𝛾) ≠ ⊥ By Definition 46 the right side holds exactly when ¬𝜏𝑛 and every 𝑘 ∈ 𝑑𝑛 lies in dom(𝜎𝛾), and dom(𝜎𝛾) = ⋃𝑚∈𝐴′ 𝑝𝑚 by Definition 69. The middle clause is the one the target no longer carries, and registration supplies it: a fiber with 𝜋𝑛 ≠ 𝗋𝗈𝗈𝗍 is registered only by an activation of 𝜋𝑛, and if 𝜋𝑛 ∉ 𝐴′ then 𝜋𝑛 is not 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾, so its accumulator has run and retired 𝑛 by Definition 47, giving 𝜏𝑛. Hence 𝐴′ satisfies the clauses of Definition 67, and Lemma 68 gives them one solution, so 𝐴 = 𝐴′. □
pairs.zh: 证明。以 𝐴′ 记右侧。没有 fiber 失败，定义 49 的 quiet 只留下 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(⊥) 与 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾，并读作 𝑛 ∈ 𝐴′ ⟺ target𝑛(𝛾) ≠ ⊥。由定义 46，右侧恰好当 ¬𝜏𝑛 且每个 𝑘 ∈ 𝑑𝑛 落在 dom(𝜎𝛾) 时成立，而由定义 69，dom(𝜎𝛾) = ⋃𝑚∈𝐴′ 𝑝𝑚。中间条款是目标不再携带者，而注册提供它：𝜋𝑛 ≠ 𝗋𝗈𝗈𝗍 的 fiber 仅由 𝜋𝑛 的激活注册；若 𝜋𝑛 ∉ 𝐴′ 则 𝜋𝑛 不是 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾，故其累加器已运行并由定义 47 退役 𝑛，给出 𝜏𝑛。故 𝐴′ 满足定义 67 的条款，引理 68 给出唯一解，从而 𝐴 = 𝐴′。□

pairs.en: Lemma 71. (Transposition.) Let the steps be pairwise independent and 𝐹𝑡 well formed, and
pairs.zh: 引理 71.（换位。）设步骤两两独立且 𝐹𝑡 良构，并

pairs.en: let steps 𝑡 and 𝑡 + 1 act on distinct fibers 𝑚 and 𝑛.
pairs.zh: 设步骤 𝑡 与 𝑡 + 1 作用于不同的 fiber 𝑚 与 𝑛。

pairs.en: 1. If both apply an activation rule, namely L-Begin, L-Iter, or L-Finish, and step 𝑡 + 1 is
pairs.zh: 1. 若二者都应用激活规则，即 L-Begin、L-Iter 或 L-Finish，且步骤 𝑡 + 1 在

pairs.en: applicable at 𝛾𝑡, then step 𝑡 is applicable at the state step 𝑡 + 1 produces from 𝛾𝑡, and the two orders reach the same 𝛾𝑡+2.
pairs.zh: 𝛾𝑡 处适用，则步骤 𝑡 在步骤 𝑡 + 1 从 𝛾𝑡 所产生的状态处适用，且两种顺序到达同一 𝛾𝑡+2。

pairs.en: 2. If step 𝑡 applies an activation rule at 𝑚, step 𝑡 + 1 an orchestration rule at 𝑛, and step 𝑡
pairs.zh: 2. 若步骤 𝑡 在 𝑚 处应用激活规则，步骤 𝑡 + 1 在 𝑛 处应用编排规则，且步骤 𝑡

pairs.en: does not register 𝑛, then the same holds of the two.
pairs.zh: 不注册 𝑛，则对二者同样成立。

pairs.en: Proof. For (1), by Table 1 the step of 𝑚 writes 𝜃𝑚 and, within Ψ𝑡 ∈ 𝔐(𝑒𝑚), the table 𝜎𝑚 and the effect part. It therefore leaves 𝜃𝑛 and 𝑖𝑛 alone, and by the second condition of Definition 60 leaves the inverse and the continuation that 𝑖𝑛 yields alone as well, so only the premises of step 𝑡 + 1 that mention target𝑛 remain to be checked. Its retirement half cannot fall, no activation rule writing a 𝜏. Its resolution half cannot move either: step 𝑡 + 1 being applicable at 𝛾𝑡 puts every 𝑘 ∈ 𝑑𝑛 in dom(𝜎𝑡), and clause (2) of Definition 58 makes the fiber providing such a 𝑘 the only one that can, so 𝑘 ∉ 𝑝𝑚 and no write of 𝜎𝑚 reaches a key of 𝑑𝑛. The same argument in the other direction leaves step 𝑡 applicable. Finally Ψ𝑡 ∈ 𝔐(𝑒𝑚) and Ψ𝑡+1 ∈ 𝔐(𝑒𝑛) commute by the first condition of Definition 60, and the two edits write control fields of distinct fibers, so the composite is the same in either order.
pairs.zh: 证明。对 (1)，由表 1，𝑚 的步骤写入 𝜃𝑚，并在 Ψ𝑡 ∈ 𝔐(𝑒𝑚) 内写入表 𝜎𝑚 与效应部分。因此它留下 𝜃𝑛 与 𝑖𝑛 不动，且由定义 60 的第二条件也留下 𝑖𝑛 所给出的逆与延续不动，故只需检查步骤 𝑡 + 1 中提及 target𝑛 的前提。其退役一半不能落下，因为没有激活规则写入 𝜏。其解析一半也不能移动：步骤 𝑡 + 1 在 𝛾𝑡 处适用使每个 𝑘 ∈ 𝑑𝑛 落在 dom(𝜎𝑡)，而定义 58 的条款 (2) 使提供此种 𝑘 的 fiber 是唯一能提供者，故 𝑘 ∉ 𝑝𝑚 且对 𝜎𝑚 的写入达不到 𝑑𝑛 的键。另一方向的同一论证使步骤 𝑡 适用。最后由定义 60 的第一条件，Ψ𝑡 ∈ 𝔐(𝑒𝑚) 与 Ψ𝑡+1 ∈ 𝔐(𝑒𝑛) 交换，且两个编辑写入不同 fiber 的控制字段，故复合在任一顺序下相同。

pairs.en: For (2), the orchestration step has Ψ𝑡+1 = idΓ by Table  1, so the two state maps commute outright, and its edit𝑡+1 writes 𝜏𝑛 or dom(𝐹𝛾) at 𝑛 alone, which the activation step neither reads nor writes: the premises of the latter read 𝜃𝑚, 𝑖𝑚, 𝜏𝑚, and target𝑚, and an O-Insert of a fresh 𝑛 moves no target, a fresh fiber providing nothing, whereas an O-Retire or O-Remove of 𝑛 leaves 𝜎𝛾 where it was, 𝑛 being 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 in the one case and unaffected in its table in the other. So step 𝑡 remains applicable. Conversely each premise of the orchestration step is either read at 𝑛, which step 𝑡 does not write, or is one of the two premises of O-Insert that a smaller registry only relaxes, whence its applicability at 𝛾𝑡+1 gives its applicability at 𝛾𝑡; here step 𝑡 not registering 𝑛 is what keeps 𝑛 present at 𝛾𝑡 where O-Retire and O-Remove require it. □
pairs.zh: 对 (2)，编排步骤由表 1 有 Ψ𝑡+1 = idΓ，故两个状态映射径直交换；其 edit𝑡+1 仅在 𝑛 处写入 𝜏𝑛 或 dom(𝐹𝛾)，而这是激活步骤既不读也不写的：后者的前提读 𝜃𝑚、𝑖𝑚、𝜏𝑚 与 target𝑚；新鲜 𝑛 的 O-Insert 不移动任何目标，因为新鲜 fiber 什么都不提供；而 𝑛 的 O-Retire 或 O-Remove 留下 𝜎𝛾 原样——前者因 𝑛 为 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾，后者因其表不受影响。故步骤 𝑡 仍适用。反过来，编排步骤的每个前提要么在 𝑛 处读取——步骤 𝑡 不写入——要么是 O-Insert 的两个前提之一，更小的注册表只会放宽它们，故其在 𝛾𝑡+1 处适用给出其在 𝛾𝑡 处适用；此处步骤 𝑡 不注册 𝑛 正是使 𝑛 在 O-Retire 与 O-Remove 要求它处的 𝛾𝑡 存在者。□

pairs.en: Lemma 72. (Deletion.) Let the sequence of steps be pairwise independent, let every compo -
pairs.zh: 引理 72.（删除。）设步骤序列两两独立，设每个组

pairs.en: nent be total on its provision ( Definition 69), let it reach a quiescent 𝛾𝑇 at which no fiber is failed, let [𝑏, 𝑢] be an episode of 𝑛 that closes, let no episode of any 𝑚 with 𝑛 ≺ 𝑚 close in the sequence, and let no fiber 𝑛 registers during [𝑏, 𝑢] have an episode. Write 𝑅 for the names those registrations draw. Then deleting the steps that act on 𝑛 in [𝑏, 𝑢], together with every step acting on a name of 𝑅, leaves a sequence of steps reaching a state ≈-equal to 𝛾𝑇 and ≃-equal to it outside 𝑅.
pairs.zh: 件在其提供上完全（定义 69），设它到达没有任何 fiber 失败的静止 𝛾𝑇，设 [𝑏, 𝑢] 为关闭的 𝑛 的插曲，设序列中没有任何满足 𝑛 ≺ 𝑚 的 𝑚 的插曲关闭，并设 [𝑏, 𝑢] 期间 𝑛 所注册的任何 fiber 都没有插曲。以 𝑅 记这些注册所取的名字。则删除 [𝑏, 𝑢] 中作用于 𝑛 的步骤，连同作用于 𝑅 中名字的每一步，留下到达与 𝛾𝑇 ≈-相等、并在 𝑅 之外与之 ≃-相等的状态的步骤序列。

pairs.en: Proof. The deleted steps leave the state where they found it. Let 𝑡1 < ⋯ < 𝑡𝑙 be the steps of [𝑏, 𝑢] that act on fibers other than 𝑛. Corollary 62 reads 𝛾𝑢+1 ≈ (Ψ𝑡𝑙 ∘ ⋯ ∘ Ψ𝑡1 )(𝛾𝑏) whose right side is what the surviving steps of [𝑏, 𝑢] produce on their own, 𝛾𝑏−1 ≈ 𝛾𝑏 and their edits writing control fields of fibers other than 𝑛 that the deletion does not touch. By Table 1 the deleted steps of 𝑛 write no field but 𝜃𝑛, which Lemma 54(4) restores to 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(⊥) at 𝑢, no fiber being failed, and which it held at 𝛾𝑏−1. An invariant carries the suffix. Write 𝛾′𝑡 for the state the surviving steps reach at the point corresponding to 𝑡. We claim, for every 𝑡 > 𝑢, that 𝛾𝑡 ≈ 𝛾′𝑡, that every name of 𝑅 is vestigial at 𝛾𝑡 and absent from 𝛾′𝑡, and that the two states agree on every field of every name outside 𝑅.
pairs.zh: 证明。被删步骤将状态留在它们所找到之处。设 𝑡1 < ⋯ < 𝑡𝑙 为 [𝑏, 𝑢] 中作用于非 𝑛 的 fiber 的步骤。推论 62 读作 𝛾𝑢+1 ≈ (Ψ𝑡𝑙 ∘ ⋯ ∘ Ψ𝑡1 )(𝛾𝑏)，其右侧正是 [𝑏, 𝑢] 的幸存步骤独自所产生者，𝛾𝑏−1 ≈ 𝛾𝑏，且它们的编辑写入删除不触及的非 𝑛 fiber 的控制字段。由表 1，𝑛 的被删步骤除 𝜃𝑛 外不写入任何字段，引理 54(4) 在 𝑢 处将其恢复为 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(⊥)（没有 fiber 失败），而它在 𝛾𝑏−1 处即持有该值。一个不变式承载后缀。以 𝛾′𝑡 记幸存步骤在对应于 𝑡 的点所达状态。我们断言，对每个 𝑡 > 𝑢，𝛾𝑡 ≈ 𝛾′𝑡，𝑅 的每个名字在 𝛾𝑡 处残余且不在 𝛾′𝑡 中，且两状态在 𝑅 之外每个名字的每个字段上一致。

pairs.en: At 𝑡 = 𝑢 + 1 this is the paragraph above together with Definition 47, which leaves each name of 𝑅 retired by the accumulator that ran at 𝑢, 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(⊥) and holding an empty table, the fibers of 𝑅 having no episode by hypothesis. The induction step is Lemma 57(1) applied at each name of 𝑅 in turn: a step acting outside 𝑅 has the same premises at the two states, reaches states again ≈-equal, and leaves the entries of 𝑅 vestigial. A step acting on a name of 𝑅 is one of the deleted ones, and Lemma 57(2) is why it has to be deleted rather than kept, an O-Retire or O-Remove of an absent name having no fiber to act on; by (1) again such a step moves no field outside 𝑅, so dropping it preserves the invariant. Hence the final states are ≈-equal, and equal outside 𝑅. No surviving step loses a premise. A step acting on 𝑚 ∉ 𝑅 ∪ {𝑛} reads 𝑛 only through target𝑚(𝛾) or relied𝑚(𝛾). The first depends on 𝑛 when 𝑚 declares a key 𝑛 provides, hence 𝑛 ≺ 𝑚, and when 𝑛 registered 𝑚, which puts 𝑚 ∈ 𝑅.
pairs.zh: 在 𝑡 = 𝑢 + 1，这是上一段连同定义 47，后者使 𝑅 的每个名字被 𝑢 处运行的累加器退役，为 𝖨𝗇𝖺𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾(⊥) 且持有空表，𝑅 的 fiber 由假设没有插曲。归纳步是引理 57(1) 依次应用于 𝑅 的每个名字：作用于 𝑅 之外的步骤在两状态有相同前提，再次到达 ≈-相等的状态，并留下 𝑅 的条目残余。作用于 𝑅 中名字的步骤是被删者之一，而引理 57(2) 说明为何必须删除而非保留——缺席名字的 O-Retire 或 O-Remove 没有 fiber 可作用；再由 (1)，此种步骤不移动 𝑅 之外的字段，故丢弃它保持不变式。故最终状态 ≈-相等，并在 𝑅 之外相等。没有幸存步骤失去前提。作用于 𝑚 ∉ 𝑅 ∪ {𝑛} 的步骤仅通过 target𝑚(𝛾) 或 relied𝑚(𝛾) 读取 𝑛。前者在 𝑚 声明 𝑛 所提供的键时依赖 𝑛，从而 𝑛 ≺ 𝑚；并在 𝑛 注册 𝑚 时依赖 𝑛，这使 𝑚 ∈ 𝑅。

pairs.en: An orchestration step at a fiber some activation registered cannot go to the front, its premises requiring that fiber to be present, so it stays where the registration put it; it acts outside 𝐴 by the paragraph above and therefore commutes with everything between it and the registration by the same clause of Lemma 71. Episodes are sorted and made contiguous, by induction on |𝐴|. Let 𝑛1 be ⊲-minimal in 𝐴. Then 𝑑𝑛1 = ⌀ and 𝜋𝑛1 = 𝗋𝗈𝗈𝗍, since Definition 67 puts a provider of a key of 𝑑𝑛1 and the fiber registering 𝑛1 in 𝐴 while ⊲ puts both below 𝑛1. So target𝑛1 reads no field of another fiber and, no orchestration step remaining to write 𝜏𝑛1 and no fiber below 𝑛1 remaining to retire it, is constant. Every step acting on 𝑛1 is an activation step, no episode closing, and its remaining premises read 𝜃𝑛1 and 𝑖𝑛1 , which by Table 1 only 𝑛1 writes; each is therefore applicable at every earlier state, and Lemma 71 moves it one place earlier without moving the endpoint.
pairs.zh: 某个激活所注册 fiber 处的编排步骤不能移到前面，其前提要求该 fiber 存在，故它留在注册所放置之处；由上一段它作用于 𝐴 之外，因而由引理 71 的同一条款与它和注册之间的一切交换。插曲被排序并做成连续的，对 |𝐴| 归纳。设 𝑛1 在 𝐴 中 ⊲-极小。则 𝑑𝑛1 = ⌀ 且 𝜋𝑛1 = 𝗋𝗈𝗈𝗍，因为定义 67 将 𝑑𝑛1 之键的提供者与注册 𝑛1 的 fiber 置于 𝐴，而 ⊲ 将二者都置于 𝑛1 之下。故 target𝑛1 不读任何其他 fiber 的字段，且由于不再有编排步骤写入 𝜏𝑛1、也不再有 𝑛1 之下的 fiber 退役它，它恒定。作用于 𝑛1 的每一步都是激活步骤，没有插曲关闭，其剩余前提读 𝜃𝑛1 与 𝑖𝑛1，由表 1 只有 𝑛1 写入它们；因此每一步在每个更早状态都适用，引理 71 将其前移一位而不移动端点。

pairs.en: The number of steps of other fibers preceding a step of 𝑛1 drops by one at each application, so the episode of 𝑛1 becomes an initial contiguous block. The argument repeats on 𝐴 ∖ {𝑛1} over the suffix that follows the block, where 𝑛1 is 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 throughout and takes no further step, so it too contributes a constant target. The enumeration this produces linearizes ⊲ by construction. For (2), both sequences reduce by (1) to a canonical one, and the two reductions run over the same 𝐴 up to a renaming. Definition 67 reads 𝜏, 𝜋, 𝑑, and 𝑝, of which the last three are written once with a fiber’s entry (Lemma 54(5)), so what has to be seen is that the same names come into existence carrying the same 𝑑, 𝑝, and 𝜋, and that the same names are retired. Insertions the two sequences share by hypothesis.
pairs.zh: 其他 fiber 的步骤先于 𝑛1 某一步的数目在每次应用时减一，故 𝑛1 的插曲成为初始连续块。论证在跟随该块的后缀上对 𝐴 ∖ {𝑛1} 重复，那里 𝑛1 始终为 𝖠𝖼𝗍𝗂𝗏𝖾 且不再采取步骤，故它也贡献恒定目标。如此产生的枚举按构造线性化 ⊲。对 (2)，两个序列都由 (1) 归约到范式，且两个归约在重命名上跑过同一 𝐴。定义 67 读 𝜏、𝜋、𝑑 与 𝑝，其中后三者与 fiber 的条目一同写入一次（引理 54(5)），故须看到相同的名字带着相同的 𝑑、𝑝 与 𝜋 出现，且相同的名字被退役。两个序列由假设共享插入。

pairs.en: Registrations they share as well: an activation of a fiber of 𝐴 registers, at each of its iterations, the component the iterator names there, which the second condition of Definition 60 holds fixed across interleavings, so the tree of registrations below an 𝐴-fiber is a function of that fiber’s component; the names those registrations draw are not shared, and it is here that Lemma 56 is applied, matching the two trees by a bijection. And a retirement is either an orchestration step, shared, or the O-Retire an accumulator takes, which retires exactly the names the same activation registered. Two enumerations linearizing ⊲ differ by transpositions of incomparable episodes, which Lemma 71 again leaves the endpoint unchanged by, so the two canonical sequences agree. With the termination of Theorem 66, the lifecycle relation therefore has unique normal forms.
pairs.zh: 它们也共享注册：𝐴 中 fiber 的激活在其每次迭代注册迭代器在那里命名的组件，定义 60 的第二条件使其在交织间固定，故 𝐴-fiber 之下的注册树是该 fiber 组件的函数；这些注册所取的名字不共享，正是此处应用引理 56，以双射匹配两棵树。而退役要么是编排步骤——共享——要么是累加器所取的 O-Retire，它恰好退役同一激活所注册的名字。线性化 ⊲ 的两个枚举相差不可比较插曲的换位，引理 71 再次使端点不变，故两个范式序列一致。结合定理 66 的终止，生命周期关系因此具有唯一范式。

pairs.en: □ Failure is excluded from the statement because it is a genuine source of divergence, and the calculus should not be read as denying it: whether a step raises depends on the state it ran against, so one schedule may fail a fiber where another completes it, and the two quiescent states then differ in that fiber’s lifecycle state. They do not differ in anything else, by Corollary 62, which puts a failed fiber’s contribution to the state at nothing. pairs.en: 4. A Calculus of Dynamic Composition
pairs.zh: 4. 动态复合演算

pairs.en: Section 3 establishes spatial and temporal composability in their local form alone. Carrying them to a whole system takes a decomposition of the system into components, each pairing a coeffect specification with a witnessed effect function, so that every interaction with the shared environment is attributable to one of them. The sections below give that decomposition an operational semantics, and establishes spatial and temporal composability in their global form. Section 4.1 and Section 4.2 present the smallest calculus in which the lifecycle can be given rules, one that takes each transition to be atomic, immediate, and infallible; Section 4.3 drops the three assumptions, atomicity once for each direction a transition may run in, admitting the forms of control flow a runtime interposes between the start of a transition and its end, and arrives at the calculus a real runtime implements; and Section 4.4 establishes the metatheory of that calculus, namely preservation, global temporal and spatial composability, progress, and confluence.
pairs.zh: 第 3 节仅以局部形式确立空间与时间可复合性。将它们带到整个系统，需要将系统分解为组件，每个组件将共效应规约与带见证的效应函数配对，从而使与共享环境的每一次交互都可归因于其中之一。以下各节为该分解给出操作语义，并确立其全局形式的空间与时间可复合性。第 4.1 节与第 4.2 节给出能用规则表述生命周期的最小演算，其中每次转换都被视为原子、即时且可靠；第 4.3 节放弃这三项假定——对转换可能运行的每个方向各放弃一次原子性——接纳运行时在转换开始与结束之间插入的控制流形式，并到达真实运行时所实现的演算；第 4.4 节确立该演算的元理论，即保持性、全局时间与空间可复合性、进展与合流。

5.  Implementation and Case Study
This section presents Cordis, which realizes the formal models of Section  3 as a practical
programming abstraction. Cordis is a meta-framework of spatiotemporal composability: unlike
application frameworks that target a specific domain (e.g., web routing, ORM, UI rendering), it
prescribes no concrete scenario; its sole responsibility is to supply universal dynamic compo­
sition semantics. The implementation is layered into three tiers: (1) the core library (Section 5.1)
implements the effect and coeffect systems directly; (2) the component loader (Section  5.2)
extends the core with configuration reconciliation and hot module replacement; and (3) appli­
cation frameworks such as Koishi (Section 5.3) build domain-specific functionality on top of
the former two tiers.

Operationally, ctx.effect is the realization of effectiter Γ (Definition 52): it takes a callback of type 𝔈iter Γ and lifts it to 𝔈iter 𝜕Γ , yielding a dispose closure that, when invoked, recovers the effect. 5.1.2.  Coeffect Operations
This section realizes reactive coeffects (Section 3.2). All coeffect operations act on three symbol-
keyed slots that each context carries:
• @@store: the value store 𝜎: (𝑟: 𝑅) ⇀𝒱︀𝑟 from realm symbols to typed values;
• @@isolate: the realm table 𝜌: Map(𝐾, 𝑅) from coeffect keys to realm symbols;
• @@intercept: the interception table 𝜄: (𝑘: 𝐾) →ℳ︀𝑘 assigning each key its metadata.
The first two compose into the two-layer resolution 𝑘→𝜌(𝑘) →𝜎(𝜌(𝑘)): ctx.get(key)
(Algorithm 2) reads the realm symbol 𝜌(𝑘) from @@isolate, then the bound value 𝜎(𝜌(𝑘)) from
@@store. The 𝜌 indirection lets isolation redirect a key to an independent binding, whereas
@@intercept is consulted only when a binding is accessed, adjusting how it is used rather
than what it resolves to. We realize these operations in two parts: (1) provision and notification,
which install or retract bindings and propagate the change to dependents; and (2) isolation and
interception, which reshape how a key resolves.

fiber.target is computed by resolving each declared key against the current coeffect store
and tupling the uid of the fiber that provides it, so it is a digest of target(𝛾, 𝑛) (Definition 46).
Identifying a binding by its provider rather than by its value is what makes a single comparison
against the recorded target sufficient: a uid is drawn fresh and never reused, so a provider that
is replaced cannot be mistaken for the one it replaced, even when the two provide equal values.
Since notify (Section 5.1.2) recomputes the target on every coeffect change, a fiber reloads
precisely when one of its declared keys comes to be provided by a different fiber. A provider
that overwrites its own binding in place is therefore not observed; a component that wants its
replacement to propagate withdraws the binding and installs it afresh.
The algorithm operates at two complementary levels. At the transition level, reload and
unload check the target at completion, enabling inertial chaining across transitions. At the
iteration level within each transition, the effect execution (Algorithm 1) checks the target at each
iteration boundary, enabling partial rollback within a single transition. These two mechanisms
correspond to the inter-transition chaining of Section 4.3.3 and the intra-transition staleness
check that Theorem 64 rests on.
Three lines carry the coeffect ordering of Theorem 63, and where each of them sits is what
makes the ordering hold. reload commits the resolved view at Line 14 and unload discards it
only after every inverse has run, so a fiber reads the same bindings for as long as it is loaded, its
own teardown included. refresh marks the fiber UNLOADING at Line 10 before the transition task
is created, which is the L-Leave step: the fiber stops providing, and the dependents recompute
against that before any of its inverses is scheduled. unload then waits at Line 25 for each notified
dependent to reach INACTIVE, which is the guard on L-Unload; notify admits a dependent only
when its declared key resolves to the same realm symbol as the provider’s, which is the runtime
form of the guard’s demand that the dependent see the key from this fiber rather than merely
declare it. The wait sits ahead of the whole recovery rather than inside one of the inverses being
waited on, since fiber.dispose initiates a fiber’s effects concurrently and a wait placed within
one of them would leave the rest unordered. Termination follows Theorem 66: a fiber only ever
waits on dependents that have already stopped being satisfiable, and a dependent that is itself
a provider waits the same way for its own, so the provider graph is traversed on demand rather
than analyzed in advance.

pairs.en: Identifying a binding by its provider rather than by its value is what makes a single comparison against the recorded target sufficient: a uid is drawn fresh and never reused, so a provider that is replaced cannot be mistaken for the one it replaced, even when the two provide equal values. Since notify (Section 5.1.2) recomputes the target on every coeffect change, a fiber reloads precisely when one of its declared keys comes to be provided by a different fiber. A provider that overwrites its own binding in place is therefore not observed; a component that wants its replacement to propagate withdraws the binding and installs it afresh. The algorithm operates at two complementary levels. At the transition level, reload and unload check the target at completion, enabling inertial chaining across transitions. At the iteration level within each transition, the effect execution (Algorithm 1) checks the target at each iteration boundary, enabling partial rollback within a single transition.

pairs.en: 5.1.4. Context Access
pairs.zh: 5.1.4. 上下文访问

ocr:
5.1.4.  Context Access
The coeffect operations of Section  5.1.2 form a reflective API: a coeffect is written with
ctx.set(key, value) and read with ctx.get(key), both keyed by name. Cordis layers a second,
more native way to extend and consume the context on top of this reflective API: property access.
A component can access a coeffect as the property ctx[key], as if it were native structure of
the context, rather than through a method call. In TypeScript, Cordis realizes this with a Proxy
whose get trap mediates every property access. Algorithm 6 shows how a context resolves such
an access to a coeffect, atop the primitive get of Section 5.1.2.
Algorithm 6 Proxy-mediated context access
1
function resolve(ctx, key)
2
fiber ← ctx.fiber
3
repeat
4
if key ∈ fiber.committed then return fiber.committed[key]
5
if key ∈ fiber.inject then throw INACTIVE_ACCESS
6
if fiber = root then throw UNDECLARED_ACCESS
7
fiber ← fiber.parent.fiber
Algorithm 6 walks the fiber chain upward from the accessing context: at the first fiber
whose committed view binds key, the access is authorized and that binding is returned; if the
walk reaches a fiber that declares key without having committed it, the fiber is not loaded
and the access fails; and if it reaches the root without any declaration, the access is rejected as
undeclared. This is where the proxy differs from the bare ctx.get: ctx.get(key) is a lookup
against the store that returns the bound value or nothing and never fails, whereas the proxy
resolves against the accessing fiber’s own view and enforces the coeffect specification 𝑑 at the
point of use. Reading the view rather than the store is also what Theorem 63 rests on, since it
is what keeps a dependency readable to a component whose teardown was triggered by that
dependency going away.
This rejection is a runtime check performed at the point of access. Because a component’s
coeffect specification 𝑑 is declared statically, the same violation is in principle detectable at
compile time, by resolving each ctx[key] against the declared 𝑑 before execution; Section 6.4
discusses how a host language’s type-level dependency declarations and compile-time
metaprogramming can carry out exactly this mediation.
5.2.  Component Loader
The core library equips component developers with imperative primitives for dynamic compo­
sition, such as ctx.effect, ctx.use, and ctx.set. A separate concern arises for application
orchestrators, who assemble pre-existing components into a running system and adjust the
composition over its lifetime. The component loader addresses this concern by introducing a de­
clarative configuration layer: the orchestrator specifies the desired composition as a persistent
data structure, and the loader translates changes to this specification into the corresponding
imperative fiber operations.
61

pairs.en: The coeffect operations of Section  5.1.2 form a reflective API: a coeffect is written with ctx.set(key, value) and read with ctx.get(key), both keyed by name. Cordis layers a second, more native way to extend and consume the context on top of this reflective API: property access. A component can access a coeffect as the property ctx[key], as if it were native structure of the context, rather than through a method call. In TypeScript, Cordis realizes this with a Proxy whose get trap mediates every property access. Algorithm 6 shows how a context resolves such an access to a coeffect, atop the primitive get of Section 5.1.2.

This is where the proxy differs from the bare ctx.get: ctx.get(key) is a lookup against the store that returns the bound value or nothing and never fails, whereas the proxy resolves against the accessing fiber’s own view and enforces the coeffect specification 𝑑 at the point of use.
pairs.zh: 算法 6 经 Proxy 中介的上下文访问 1 function resolve(ctx, key) 2 fiber ← ctx.fiber 3 repeat 4 if key ∈ fiber.committed then return fiber.committed[key] 5 if key ∈ fiber.inject then throw INACTIVE_ACCESS 6 if fiber = root then throw UNDECLARED_ACCESS 7 fiber ← fiber.parent.fiber 算法 6 从访问上下文向上走 fiber 链：在第一个其已提交视图绑定 key 的 fiber 处，访问被授权并返回该绑定；若走到声明了 key 但尚未提交它的 fiber，则 fiber 未加载且访问失败；若走到根而没有任何声明，则访问被拒绝为未声明。这正是 proxy 与裸 ctx.get 的不同：ctx.get(key) 是对照存储的查找，返回绑定值或无，永不失败；而 proxy 对照访问 fiber 自有视图解析，并在使用点强制共效应规约 𝑑。

pairs.en: Reading the view rather than the store is also what Theorem 63 rests on, since it is what keeps a dependency readable to a component whose teardown was triggered by that dependency going away. This rejection is a runtime check performed at the point of access. Because a component’s coeffect specification 𝑑 is declared statically, the same violation is in principle detectable at compile time, by resolving each ctx[key] against the declared 𝑑 before execution; Section 6.4 discusses how a host language’s type-level dependency declarations and compile-time metaprogramming can carry out exactly this mediation.
pairs.zh: 读视图而非存储也是定理 63 所依赖者，因为它使因该依赖离去而触发拆除的组件仍可读该依赖。此种拒绝是在访问点执行的运行时检查。由于组件的共效应规约 𝑑 静态声明，原则上同一违规可在编译时检测，通过在执行前对照所声明的 𝑑 解析每个 ctx[key]；第 6.4 节讨论宿主语言的类型级依赖声明与编译时元编程如何恰好执行此种中介。
